item.title: Patient Reviews
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
See what people are saying about us!

Whether you are a long-time patient or new to our office, we would love to hear from you. If you’ve had an experience at Artisan Dental that you would like to share with us or with others, please feel free to contact us directly. info@artisandentalmadison.com

View All Google Reviews View All Yelp Reviews View All Facebook Reviews View All Healthgrade Reviews View All WebMD Reviews View Business Review Central Reviews Best dental office in Madison hands down! Caring staff, highly skilled dentists, hygienists, and assistants. Amazing technology and beautiful office. Would not trust anyone else with my family’s care. Thank you for being amazing! Awesome people and great at talking over that they are doing. I HATE the dentist, but I like it here. My first experience at Artisan Dental was fantastic! They treated me with an amazing amount of care, consideration and precision. The office and staff make the entire experience feel like a spa. I will certainly be recommending Artisan Dental to anyone looking for a dental office in Madison. Very friendly, thorough cleaning, clean and modern office. Highly recommend. My visit to Artisan Dental today has been the most amazing dental visit I have ever had! Dr. Mark Rehermann was so skilled I can honestly say it was absolutely painless. Highly recommend! Best dentist office! They’re always clean, punctual, friendly, and professional. Also love that they’re a B Corp company. Major kudos! They are taking appropriate COVID precautions. They screen all patients with a comprehensive questionnaire, they have barriers between patients and reception, their staff wear the appropriate masks, they use aerosol reduction techniques for cleanings, and they're giving out hand sanitizer. Overall, felt safe and low-risk. Always appreciate the friendliness of the staff, as well! I was very happy with my visit today. I had Destinee at my hygienist and she was so nice and explained everything she was doing before she did it. They had good safety precautions in place and I felt very comfortable. It’s located in my neighborhood, so for me this place is very convenient. There’s street parking and also free 2-hour parking in the garage. I had a dental emergency today and Artisan Dental saw me through it. Great people and great service! I was in town visiting Epic and had an unexpected dental emergency. This was quite distressing since I was so far from my normal dentist in Cincinnati. Thank goodness I found Artisan Dental! They got me in quickly and did a great job. Everyone from the office staff to the hygienist to the dentist was very calming and helpful! Above and beyond. I couldn’t be happier with my experience. Everyone was kind and courteous. There wasn’t a long waiting period for anything. Lindsay (dental hygienist) was very patient and took great care of me with my cleaning and X-rays. Thank you! The staff is nice and always checking on your comfort level. Despite being in the chair for over half an hour it doesn’t really feel too long. They are more than happy to discuss your insurance plan to ensure that you’re getting the most out of your dental plan and benefits. Fantastic group of people who have done great work and helped alleviate my extreme anxiety about dental work. This place is first class all around. Lindsay was an amazing dental hygienist. Courteous, knowledgeable. Dr Mierick was great too. Receptionist as well. Great hospitality, latest technology. I made a great choice! I’ve not been to a spa but this place reminds me of one with its fruit water, comforting color scheme throughout the waiting area, and tv screens that display tropical settings. I guess it helps to reduce your anxiety if your anxious about going to the dentist. Always enjoy my time with Artisan Dental as everyone is super friendly & helpful! Very clean/sanitary office spaces so I also felt safe coming in during the COVID crisis. Was very anxious about having plaque removed after not having a cleaning for over two years. Kind, compassionate and have great results. A plan was put into place to get my teeth and gums back to 100%. The team is very professional and even though I had procrastinated on work to be done, the team performed the work professionally and without judgement. Really a positive place to be. The Artisan Dental staff are so kind and friendly, it’s always a treat to go in and get my teeth cleaned. I love that they do the toothpaste tube and toothbrush recycling as well. As always, Artisan Dental is an excellent experience.. Excellent experience from start to finish. All staff very friendly and explained what was going to happen before proceeding. Every staff member went to extremes to protect against covid. Very impressed. Last night, I called them and left a message about my broken molar. They texted right away this morning and I went in today with a fractured molar and they fit me in unexpectedly and were friendly, reassuring, and fast! I walked out with a filling and a smile! Had a cavity filled and honestly wouldn't complain if I had to get another one filled with them ;) Hands down the best dentist experience I have ever had. Staff is excellent from the reception desk to the hygienists to the dentists. The hygienist and dentist really listened and explained next steps well. Was presented with options to make the best decision for my needs. It felt more like a partnership rather than a feeling of helplessness sitting in a dentist chair

Best dental office in Madison hands down! Caring staff, highly skilled dentists, hygienists, and assistants. Amazing technology and beautiful office. Would not trust anyone else with my family’s care. Thank you for being amazing!
Awesome people and great at talking over that they are doing. I HATE the dentist, but I like it here.
My first experience at Artisan Dental was fantastic! They treated me with an amazing amount of care, consideration and precision. The office and staff make the entire experience feel like a spa. I will certainly be recommending Artisan Dental to anyone looking for a dental office in Madison.
Very friendly, thorough cleaning, clean and modern office. Highly recommend.
My visit to Artisan Dental today has been the most amazing dental visit I have ever had! Dr. Mark Rehermann was so skilled I can honestly say it was absolutely painless. Highly recommend!
Best dentist office! They’re always clean, punctual, friendly, and professional. Also love that they’re a B Corp company. Major kudos!
They are taking appropriate COVID precautions. They screen all patients with a comprehensive questionnaire, they have barriers between patients and reception, their staff wear the appropriate masks, they use aerosol reduction techniques for cleanings, and they're giving out hand sanitizer. Overall, felt safe and low-risk. Always appreciate the friendliness of the staff, as well!
I was very happy with my visit today. I had Destinee at my hygienist and she was so nice and explained everything she was doing before she did it. They had good safety precautions in place and I felt very comfortable.
It’s located in my neighborhood, so for me this place is very convenient. There’s street parking and also free 2-hour parking in the garage.
I had a dental emergency today and Artisan Dental saw me through it. Great people and great service!
I was in town visiting Epic and had an unexpected dental emergency. This was quite distressing since I was so far from my normal dentist in Cincinnati. Thank goodness I found Artisan Dental! They got me in quickly and did a great job. Everyone from the office staff to the hygienist to the dentist was very calming and helpful!
Above and beyond. I couldn’t be happier with my experience. Everyone was kind and courteous. There wasn’t a long waiting period for anything. Lindsay (dental hygienist) was very patient and took great care of me with my cleaning and X-rays. Thank you!
The staff is nice and always checking on your comfort level. Despite being in the chair for over half an hour it doesn’t really feel too long. They are more than happy to discuss your insurance plan to ensure that you’re getting the most out of your dental plan and benefits.
Fantastic group of people who have done great work and helped alleviate my extreme anxiety about dental work.
This place is first class all around. Lindsay was an amazing dental hygienist. Courteous, knowledgeable. Dr Mierick was great too. Receptionist as well. Great hospitality, latest technology. I made a great choice!
I’ve not been to a spa but this place reminds me of one with its fruit water, comforting color scheme throughout the waiting area, and tv screens that display tropical settings. I guess it helps to reduce your anxiety if your anxious about going to the dentist.
Always enjoy my time with Artisan Dental as everyone is super friendly & helpful! Very clean/sanitary office spaces so I also felt safe coming in during the COVID crisis.
Was very anxious about having plaque removed after not having a cleaning for over two years. Kind, compassionate and have great results. A plan was put into place to get my teeth and gums back to 100%.
The team is very professional and even though I had procrastinated on work to be done, the team performed the work professionally and without judgement. Really a positive place to be.
The Artisan Dental staff are so kind and friendly, it’s always a treat to go in and get my teeth cleaned. I love that they do the toothpaste tube and toothbrush recycling as well. As always, Artisan Dental is an excellent experience..
Excellent experience from start to finish. All staff very friendly and explained what was going to happen before proceeding. Every staff member went to extremes to protect against covid. Very impressed.
Last night, I called them and left a message about my broken molar. They texted right away this morning and I went in today with a fractured molar and they fit me in unexpectedly and were friendly, reassuring, and fast! I walked out with a filling and a smile!
Had a cavity filled and honestly wouldn't complain if I had to get another one filled with them ;) Hands down the best dentist experience I have ever had. Staff is excellent from the reception desk to the hygienists to the dentists.
The hygienist and dentist really listened and explained next steps well. Was presented with options to make the best decision for my needs. It felt more like a partnership rather than a feeling of helplessness sitting in a dentist chair

item.title: Insurance Assistance
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
We accept most dental insurance programs.

Our staff will take the lead in gathering information on your coverage prior to your appointment. We will help you understand what type of coverage you have without you having to decipher the complexities of the insurance business and its language.

It is important for you to understand that your dental insurance is a contract between you and the insurance company, which is often set up by your employer. If you have concerns regarding the type of coverage it is best to talk with your employer or the insurance company directly.

All estimated co-pays and deductibles are due at the time of service.

item.title: Payment + Financing Options
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Pay Now Directly

Make Payment

Care Credit

Apply Now

Option 1

  • The Artisan Dental Health Plan offers significant savings on regular teeth cleanings, diagnostic radiographs and dental exams as well as 15% savings on restorative and cosmetic dental services.  Click here to learn more.

 

Option 2

  • We accept checks, cash or major credit cards Visa, MasterCard, and Discover.

 

Option 3

  • As a service to our patients, we are pleased to offer a financing option: CareCredit. You can finance 100% of your dental care and there are no upfront costs, no annual fees, and no pre-payment penalties. So, you can begin your treatment today and conveniently pay with low, monthly payments.
 

CareCredit offer a full range of payment plans so you can find one that works best for you. With the promotional no interest payment plans there are no interest charges if you pay your balance in full within the specified time period. For longer payment terms, 24-60 month plan options with low monthly payments are available.

These options can be used by the whole family for ongoing treatment without having to reapply. And by using one of these financing options for your dental care, you can save your other credit cards for household or unplanned expenses. It only takes a few minutes to apply and you’ll receive an online decision in seconds!

item.content:encoded:
PATIENT FORMS

New and existing patients can securely fill out forms and schedule or view future appointments. We are always happy to talk to you in person if you’d prefer to give us a call at 608.467.8022. All your information is always handled in strictest confidence in accordance with the HIPAA Act of 1996.

New and Current Patients

Request Appointment

Online Forms

10 North Livingston Street, Suite 301, Madison, Wisconsin 53703 | Office: 608.467.8022

 Hours of Operation: Monday – Friday 7:00am – 5:00pm

Free Parking in the Constellation Building

Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy:  Please contact us at least 48 hours prior to your scheduled visit to enable other patients to be cared for during your appointment time. If appropriate notice is not given, the patient may be charged a scheduling fee to reschedule this appointment.  The fee would be forfeited if that appointment is not kept.

item.title: Code of Conduct
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Artisan Dental Ethical Code of Conduct

Artisan Dental is committed to continually enacting its mission, vision and values in the service of all of its stakeholders. To support the realization of its mission and vision and the expression of our values, Artisan Dental’s team members will adhere to the highest standards of ethical conduct.

The Artisan Dental Ethical Code of Conduct is informed by the American Dental Association Principles of Ethics and Code of Professional Conduct (ADA Code) and American College of Dentists Aspirational Code of Ethics.

Artisan Dental team members recognize and appreciate that continued public trust in Artisan Dental and the dental profession is based on the commitment of individual healthcare practitioners to high ethical standards of conduct.

Ethical Conduct Core Values and Conduct

Autonomy

Artisan Dental team members recognize the dignity and intrinsic worth of individuals and their right to make personal choices.

Patient First

Artisan Dental team members act in the best interests of patients even when there is conflict with the health care practitioners personal self-interest or the organization's self-interest. Artisan Dental team members will not recommend or perform unnecessary dental services or procedures. Artisan Dental team members inform patients of the proposed treatment, and any reasonable alternatives, in a way that is understandable and allows patients to become involved in the treatment decisions.

Compassion

Artisan Dental team members are sensitive, empathetic and compassionate with an individual’s need for physical, emotional and mental comfort and support.

Competence

Artisan Dental team members strive to achieve the highest level of knowledge, skill, and ability within their capacity. Team members should seek consultation, if possible, whenever the welfare of patients will be safeguarded or advanced by utilizing those who have specialized skills, knowledge, and experience.

Truth

Artisan Dental team members value truthfulness and honesty as the basis for trust in personal and professional relationships. Artisan Dental team members shall seek truth in the use and advancement of scientific knowledge and make relevant oral health care information available to patients, colleagues and society.

Tolerance

Artisan Dental team members respect the rights and perspectives of individuals who hold views that may arise from diverse personal, ethnic or cultural norms.

Professionalism

Artisan Dental team members are committed to involvement in professional activities that enhance knowledge, skill, judgment, and professional development for the benefit of patients, the community, the profession and society. Artisan Dental team members shall be honest with patients and colleagues and appropriately report those who are deemed to be incompetent or engaged in fraud, bribery, deception or corruption.

Safety and Security

Artisan Dental team members are responsible for safeguarding the confidentiality of patient records. Artisan Dental team members will maintain patient records and patient information in a manner consistent with the protection of the welfare of the patient and consistent with HIPAA laws. Upon request of a patient or another dental practitioner, Artisan Dental will provide any information consistent with applicable laws.

Integrity

Artisan Dental team members express these core values through their daily behavior, as the basis for ethical practice and the foundation for honorable character.

Governance of the Professional Code of Conduct

Artisan Dental’s co-owners, director of business development, director of operations and finance, director of human resources and compliance and director of stakeholder stewardship are responsible for reviewing the compliance with professional code of conduct on an annual basis. Any non-compliance with this policy will be brought to the attention of the aforementioned members of the Artisan Dental leadership team, who will decide on further action. Artisan Dental team members will receive yearly training on the code of conduct.

item.title: Program Details
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Call Today for More Information! 608-467-8022

The Artisan Dental recycling program is the first oral care products recycling program in the Dane County area.  The program is designed to help keep toothbrushes, toothpaste tubes, floss containers, deodorant container, soap wrappers and mouthwash containers out of landfills. The Artisan Dental Recycling Program participates in the Tom’s of Maine Natural Care Brigade®, a recycling program sponsored by Tom’s of Maine ® and TerraCycle®.

The Artisan Dental Recycling program is also able to earn money for charity.  For each piece of waste sent to TerraCycle, Artisan Dental earns two points which are converted into a cash donation to Feeding America.  Materials collected as part of the Artisan Dental Recycling program will be recycled into a variety of products, such as cutting boards, trash cans and bath caddies.

item.title: Specific Product Info
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
What can you recycle? Take a look!

As a sustainable business, we aim to enhance the social and ecological relationships we have with our community and environment. We would like to share some options for responsible disposal of the products we offer. We have put together this chart to help you understand your options for the proper recycling of used oral care items.

Our Recycling Program

Through Terracycle, we are able to accept toothbrushes, toothpaste tubes, mouthwash bottles, deodorant, soap wrappers and floss containers for recycling. We box these and send them to be recycled and remade into new products.

You can recycle too!

Don’t want to hold on to your oral care products until your next appointment? No problem! You can start your own collection of oral care products to be sent for recycling. Visit www.terracycle.com and learn about their options. You can even get your friends, relatives, neighbors and coworkers to help you fill your bin!

Electric Toothbrushes and WaterPiks

There are certain products that cannot be accepted through terracycle. These include electric toothbrushes and waterpiks.  Most electric toothbrushes contain rechargeable batteries in the base of the brush that must be removed and recycled separately.  Once the parts have been disassembled then they can be accepted by the City of Madison.  Visit https://www.cityofmadison.com/streets/recycling/ to find the proper drop off location for your products.  

SureSmile/Invisalign Retainers

Once you have finished your entire clear aligner treatment, bring the used trays back and we can recycle them for you. You can also return your worn nightguards, athletic guards and bleaching trays once you no longer need them.

Other Low-waste options

Proper recycling of electric toothbrushes and water flossers can be complicated and time consuming. One option is to purchase products that are produced in such a way to be easy to recycle and create less waste.

Toothbrushes

While most toothbrushes can be recycled through Terracycle, some companies offer brushes that create less waste from the beginning. Both EcoDent and Radius make a toothbrush with a replaceable head. The head of the brush can be recycled and the handle is reusable. This saves from having to send handles for plastics processing and recycling. You can find these products at www.eco-dent.com and www.madebyradius.com   

Quip is a company that makes electric toothbrushes. The battery in their toothbrushes is easy to remove and replace unlike more traditional toothbrushes that have a built in battery.  This allows you to use your own rechargeable battery or they can provide one for you as part of their “go green” package.  Now you will not be in the situation where the brush is functionable but the rechargeable battery is dead rendering the whole unit unusable. You can find these at www.getquip.com

Waterpiks and Water Flossers

Electric waterpiks and water flossers have similar challenges to the traditional electric toothbrushes when it comes to recycling. Another option is to use a water flosser that is not powered by electricity!

Oral Breeze has created a water flosser that attaches to either your sink tap or directly to your shower. This uses the pressure from the faucet to power the water, no batteries required! You can find more details at www.oralbreeze.com

Another option that is more portable is the Pocket Flosser. This is a water flosser that is powered by a pump you can operate with your hand.  This is a great option for people who are often on the go and do not want to take their large bathroom-based water flosser along for the ride. You can get more information on these products at www.pocketflosserusa.com. Once again, no batteries required!

Still unsure what to do with your used oral care products and casings?

Feel free to call us or send us an email with any questions you may have regarding responsible disposal of your products.  We are always around to help.  It is up to us to help preserve the planet for future generations!

Visit\u00a0www.terracycle.com<\/a>\u00a0and learn about their options. You can even get your friends, relatives, neighbors and coworkers to help you fill your bin!<\/p>

Electric Toothbrushes and WaterPiks<\/h5>

There are certain products that cannot be accepted through terracycle. These include electric toothbrushes and waterpiks. \u00a0Most electric toothbrushes contain rechargeable batteries in the base of the brush that must be removed and recycled separately. \u00a0Once the parts have been disassembled then they can be accepted by the City of Madison.\u00a0 Visit\u00a0https:\/\/www.cityofmadison.com\/streets\/recycling\/<\/a>\u00a0to find the proper drop off location for your products. \u00a0<\/p>

SureSmile\/Invisalign Retainers<\/h5>

Once you have finished your entire clear aligner treatment, bring the used trays back and we can recycle them for you. You can also return your worn nightguards, athletic guards and bleaching trays once you no longer need them.<\/p>

Other Low-waste options<\/h5>

Proper recycling of electric toothbrushes and water flossers can be complicated and time consuming. One option is to purchase products that are produced in such a way to be easy to recycle and create less waste.<\/p>

Toothbrushes<\/h5>

While most toothbrushes can be recycled through Terracycle, some companies offer brushes that create less waste from the beginning. Both EcoDent and Radius make a toothbrush with a replaceable head. The head of the brush can be recycled and the handle is reusable. This saves from having to send handles for plastics processing and recycling. You can find these products at\u00a0www.eco-dent.com<\/a>\u00a0and\u00a0www.madebyradius.com<\/a>\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0<\/p>

Quip is a company that makes electric toothbrushes. The battery in their toothbrushes is easy to remove and replace unlike more traditional toothbrushes that have a built in battery. \u00a0This allows you to use your own rechargeable battery or they can provide one for you as part of their \u201cgo green\u201d package.\u00a0 Now you will not be in the situation where the brush is functionable but the rechargeable battery is dead rendering the whole unit unusable. You can find these at\u00a0www.getquip.com<\/a><\/p>

Waterpiks and Water Flossers<\/h5>

Electric waterpiks and water flossers have similar challenges to the traditional electric toothbrushes when it comes to recycling. Another option is to use a water flosser that is not powered by electricity!<\/p>

Oral Breeze has created a water flosser that attaches to either your sink tap or directly to your shower. This uses the pressure from the faucet to power the water, no batteries required! You can find more details at\u00a0www.oralbreeze.com<\/a><\/p>

Another option that is more portable is the Pocket Flosser. This is a water flosser that is powered by a pump you can operate with your hand. \u00a0This is a great option for people who are often on the go and do not want to take their large bathroom-based water flosser along for the ride. You can get more information on these products at\u00a0www.pocketflosserusa.com<\/a>. Once again, no batteries required!<\/p>","_ha_condition_list":[{"_ha_condition_key":"login_status","_ha_condition_operator":"is","_ha_condition_login_status":"login","_id":"aef183a","_ha_condition_role":"subscriber","_ha_condition_operating_system":"mac_os","_ha_condition_browser":"chrome","_ha_condition_date_range":"19-08-2020 to 21-08-2020","_ha_condition_date":"19-08-2020","_ha_condition_time":"12:00","_ha_condition_day":"monday"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"c1d7b6c","elType":"widget","settings":{"image":{"url":"https:\/\/scott-andersen.eblocks.io\/wp-content\/uploads\/2020\/08\/RYOC.jpg","id":"627"},"align":"left","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":""},"_ha_condition_list":[{"_ha_condition_key":"login_status","_ha_condition_operator":"is","_ha_condition_login_status":"login","_id":"9b5c691","_ha_condition_role":"subscriber","_ha_condition_operating_system":"mac_os","_ha_condition_browser":"chrome","_ha_condition_date_range":"19-08-2020 to 21-08-2020","_ha_condition_date":"19-08-2020","_ha_condition_time":"12:00","_ha_condition_day":"monday"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"image"},{"id":"3c095ed","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

item.title: Dr. Nicole Andersen
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
About Dr. Andersen:

Artisan Dental is the product of Dr. Andersen’s vision, training and values.

Dr. Andersen graduated from the University of Iowa with a B.A. in Biology and a D.D.S. degree from the College of Dentistry. She has been in private practice since 1998.

Continuing education and staying connected with the newest techniques, products, and equipment is essential to a journey of excellence.  Dr. Andersen’s passion for learning has resulted in her devoting hundreds of hours to higher learning, including hands-on clinics with some of the best instructors in the world.

Learn more about the specific post-graduate continuing education courses and hands-on clinics Dr. Andersen has participated in below, including studying under the direction of Dr. Newton Fahl Jr., Fahl Center, Dr. Pete Dawson, The Dawson Academy, Dr. Pascal Magne, Interdisciplinary Dental Education Academy, Dr. Arun Garg, Implant Seminars, Frank Spear, Spear Education and Dr. David Hornbrook of the Hornbrook Group.

Dr. Andersen graduated with honors from the Hornbrook Group’s distinguished national clinical training program in Chicago, IL. This hands-on program in cosmetic dentistry focuses on smile design and enhancement using the latest state-of-the-art technology and materials. Nationwide, only one percent of dentists graduate from this type of advanced training institute.

Based upon reviews by local dentists and specialists Dr. Andersen was selected as a “Top Dentist” from 2011 – 2026.

Dr. Andersen married Scott Andersen in 2002, and they are the proud parents of two children. In her free time, she enjoys reading, walking her dogs, and spending time with family.

Postgraduate Education

  • Spear Education Seminars, AZ, 2015 - present
  • Implant Seminars, Implant Dentistry Continuums, Dr. Arun Garg, New York, NY 2013
  • Esthetic Restorations, Interdisciplinary Dental Education Academy,  Dr. Pascal Magne, San Francisco, CA, 2011
  • Mastering Composite Artistry, Fahl Center, Dr. Newton Fahl, Curitiba, Brazil, 2010
  • Postgraduate Program in Esthetic Dentistry, University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, MN, 2009-2010
  • Biometric Diagnostics, Dr. Barry Glassman, Milwaukee, WI. 2009
  • San Diego Laser Dental Study Group, Laser Assisted Dentistry, Las Vegas, NV, 2009
  • Seattle Study Club of Madison, 2009 – 2017
  • Hornbrook Group, Full Mouth Rehabilitation, Louisville, KY, 2008
  • Hornbrook Group, Occlusion 1, Chicago, IL, 2007
  • Hornbrook Group, Anterior Aesthetics, Chicago, IL, 2006
  • Invisalign, Preferred Provider 2014 – Present
  • Invisalign, Orthodontic Certification II, 2008
  • Invisalign, Orthodontic Certification I, 2007
  • Dawson Center for Advanced Dental Study, Complete Dentistry II St. Petersburg, FL, 2001
  • Dawson Center for Advanced Dental Study, Complete Dentistry I, St. Petersburg, FL, 2000

Education

  • University of Iowa College of Dentistry, Doctor of Dental Surgery, 1998
  • University of Iowa, Bachelor of Arts, 1994

Professional Memberships

  • American Dental Association
  • Wisconsin Dental Association
  • Greater Dane Dental Society

item.title: Dr. Mark Rehermann
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
About Dr. Rehermann:

Dr. Mark Rehermann is a comprehensive dentist whose commitment to serving others and passion for oral health and facial esthetics has made him an exemplary professional in his field.

Originally from Pennsylvania, Dr. Rehermann completed his undergraduate studies at Penn State University. His affinity for science and a desire to make a positive impact on people's lives led him to pursue a career in dentistry. Graduating magna cum laude in 2012, he demonstrated academic excellence from the outset. He went on to earn his Doctor of Dental Medicine degree at the University of Pittsburgh School of Dental Medicine in 2016.  

After dental school, Dr. Rehermann embarked on an extraordinary path of service by joining the U.S. Army. He was awarded a scholarship from the military's Health Professional Scholarship Program and completed a one-year Advanced Education in General Dentistry residency.

After his residency, Dr. Rehermann was stationed in various locations, including Kentucky, South Korea, and Georgia. He encountered a diverse range of oral health issues and gained invaluable experience in providing dental care under challenging circumstances. This exposure to different cultures, communities, and dental practices has made him a versatile and well-rounded practitioner.

In 2020, Dr. Rehermann moved to Madison, Wisconsin, where he joined our team. With a focus on providing comprehensive and compassionate dental services, he has become a trusted professional in the Madison community, known for his gentle chairside manner and commitment to patient education.

Dr. Rehermann has also received specialized training from the American Academy of Facial Esthetics (AAFE) for administering botox and dermal fillers. This additional expertise allows him to offer a wider range of esthetic services to his patients with the goal of enhancing their overall dental experience.

Based upon reviews by local dentists and specialists Dr. Rehermann was selected as a “Top Dentist” from 2026.

Dr. Rehermann's journey exemplifies his passion for dentistry and his dedication to serving others. Through his education, military service, and private practice, he has become a highly skilled and compassionate dentist. He strives to make a positive impact on the oral health and overall well-being of his patients, while upholding the highest standards of dental care. 

Education:

  • U.S. Army 1-year AEGD, 2017
  • University of Pittsburgh School of Dental Medicine, 2016
  • Pennsylvania State University, 2012

Postgraduate Education:

  • MedAesthetics Training, 2020
  • American Academy of Facial Esthetics Level I Botox and Dermal Fillers (2021)
  • American Academy of Facial Esthetics Level II Botox and Dermal Fillers (2022)
  • American Academy of Facial Esthetics Level III Botox and Dermal Fillers (2022)
  • WhiteCap Institute Implant Bootcamp (2023)

Professional Memberships:

  • American Academy of Facial Esthetic
  • American Dental Association
  • Wisconsin Dental Association
  • Greater Dane Dental Society

item.title: Dr. Shruthi Dayal
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Dayal is honored to join the Artisan Dental team in providing high quality comprehensive dental care.

Dr. Dayal graduated from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 2011 with a B.S. in Genetics. 

Upon completion of her bachelor degree Dr. Dayal spent a year as an elementary school English teacher in Pyeontaek, South Korea. She went on to receive her D.D.S from New York University College of Dentistry in 2016.

After receiving her D.D.S Dr. Dayal continued her training and education as a general practice resident at New York Presbyterian Weill-Cornell hospital in Manhattan working in a hospital- based clinic with rotations in oral surgery, pediatrics, anesthesia, and urgent care. As part of her training Dr. Dayal also worked alongside dental oncologists seeing patients in the Head and Neck Cancer department at Memorial Sloan Kettering.

Dr. Dayal looks forward to creating quality relationships with her patients based on her ability to diagnose, treat, and educate them about their oral health. “I feel lucky to have chosen a dynamic and influential profession that requires long-lasting relationships with my patients to keep their smiles healthy and beautiful. I truly believe in the healing power of dentistry and its ability to change lives.”

Dr. Dayal is truly passionate about her career, and is on a mission to change the public perception and fear about Dentistry. “I’m here to prove that dentistry doesn’t have to be surrounded by anxiety and fear.”

When she’s not fixing smiles, Dr. Dayal enjoys reading, camping, and hiking. She is also an avid food connoisseur who enjoys trying new restaurants and recipes.

Post Graduate Education:

  • Root Camp, Endodontic Training, Miami 2022
  • Art of Endodontics, Dr. Buchanan, Santa Barbara 2021

Education:

  • Sleep Apnea 3D Dentists seminar, Denver CO 2024 
  • New York Presbyterian-Weil Cornell, General Practice Residency, 2017
  • New York University College of Dentistry, 2016
  • University of Wisconsin, Madison, Genetics, 2011

Professional Memberships:

  • Greater Dane Dental Society 
  • Wisconsin Dental Association
  • American Dental Association

item.title: Jill
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Registered Dental Hygienist & Director of Operations and Finance

I am thrilled to have worked with Dr. Andersen since 1999 and to have been part of the original startup of Artisan Dental. I graduated from Madison College’s Dental Hygiene School in 1995. I feel fortunate to be able to work both as a Dental Hygienist and be the Director of Finance and Operations at Artisan Dental. Customer service and quality care are our top priorities for our patients. 

A few things about me. I was born and raised in Monona and now live in Cottage Grove with my husband and two teddy bear dogs! We are newly empty nesters, having two adult daughters that have not settled down in one spot yet, so we enjoy traveling to see them wherever they might be.  We also enjoy traveling to northern Wisconsin when possible during the summer and visiting family in Arizona during the winter months. We enjoy golfing, fishing, UTV riding and going to dinner with friends! We are always up for new adventures.

I look forward to working with you to make your Artisan Dental experience the best dental experience you have ever had!

item.title: Scott Andersen
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Director of Stakeholder Stewardship

I work collaboratively with Dr. Andersen and the entire Artisan team to ensure we are providing you with compassionate care that is of the highest quality. My responsibilities range from cultivating relationships with our various community and industry partners to research and development of new services we can offer at Artisan Dental. My previous professional experiences include founding and directing several businesses and roles with two global healthcare organizations.  I graduated with honors from Mount Mercy University in 1995 with an Interdisciplinary B.A. in the Social Sciences and a Business Administration minor. As always, we welcome your feedback around ways that we can enhance the quality of your care and experience at Artisan Dental.

In my free time, I enjoy spending time with my wife and two children, reading, traveling and volunteering in our community as a coach, teacher and active member of various non-profit and civic boards.

item.title: Cassandra
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Equipment and Maintenance Team Leader

In 2018 I became a Dental Assistant. I am so lucky to have been working at Artisan Dental for 5 years now! We focus on offering treatment that is empathetic and compassionate. I couldn’t be more overjoyed to be working with our team.  

My husband and I are recently married. We both love the outdoors, hiking, TRAVELING,  hanging out with friends, going to badger games, trying new restaurants and different food Madison has to offer.  I am originally from Menomonie WI, but have been in Madison for 13 years. I am also very passionate about being healthy. I love going to the gym and also taking cycling classes in the area. 

We love traveling to different locations and would love recommendations! I couldn’t be happier to be working at Artisan Dental. I can’t wait to meet you!

item.title: Lindsay
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Director of Human Resources and Compliance

When people ask what my favorite part of Dental Hygiene is, I always say the individualized care and treatment coordinating with patients! I love to listen and learn, not only patients’ specific oral health needs but everyone’s unique, exciting lifestyles! 

Since 2015, I have enjoyed working with patients to obtain healthier oral hygiene habits through comprehensive care, educational resources, administering local anesthetic and nitrous oxide, and providing care with laser therapy. 

I find it wonderful that the team at Artisan can collaborate with patients, and together, we can improve your oral health so you can see changes in other areas of your daily life! 

I am originally from Northern Illinois and moved to Madison following graduation. My family and I reside in Sun Prairie, where we love enjoying everything the growing city has to offer while still being very close to downtown! We love staying active through the gym, hiking, and going on walks with our dogs. We LOVE traveling and are always interested in any location recommendations! When we are home, you can catch us grilling, creating something yummy in the kitchen, spending time with friends and family, and watching any Wisconsin sport! I look forward to meeting all of you!
item.excerpt:encoded: Director of Human Resources and Compliance

item.title: Jonlyn
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Clinical Assistant Team Lead

Dental Assisting was a career that found me! And has been the best opportunity I could have ever asked for. I have been a clinical assistant for over 10 years and continue to develop new skills every day! I love the fact that Artisan Dental focuses not only on the clinical side of dentistry but also the community. I believe our B Corp certification is amazing and I am proud to be part of such an important way to start taking care of our planet!

I am a flea market junkie! And love treasure hunting with my college daughters. I have been married for over 25 years and have lived in Cottage Grove for most of my life! We have 4 crazy German Shorthaired Pointers that I cannot live without! I love to run and be outside as much as possible, though I’m still not sold on the winter thing around here!

item.title: Adria
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Patient Care Coordinator Team Lead

I have been working in the dental field since 2014 and I have been at Artisan Dental since 2017. I am so grateful to be part of the team and help provide our patients with exceptional quality care that is empathetic, caring and compassionate. One of my favorite things about working at Artisan Dental is our commitment to sustainability.

When I’m not at work you can find me in the bleachers cheering on my step sons’ at their numerous sporting events, hiking the Ice Age Trail with my husband and our dogs, or traveling to places that we have never been. 

I am looking forward to helping make your experience at Artisan Dental the best one yet!

item.title: Kat
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Patient Care Coordinator

I have been in the dental field since 2016. I’m so grateful that the dental world found me. I have always been teeth obsessed and loved getting my teeth cleaned. Dentistry isn’t always cosmetic and has great overall health benefits as well. My favorite thing is seeing the outcome and confidence that people leave with after each appointment. Sometimes going to the dentist is like going to the gym, the hardest part is getting there.
What I love about Artisan Dental is the teamwork between the staff. The care for the community, and the patients as a whole. I’m very blessed to be a part of the Artisan Dental community. What I’m looking forward to the most is building relationships with all the patients. We truly have the best ones!

When I’m not at work I enjoy trying new restaurants, especially Wisconsin supper clubs. All my teeth are sweet teeth so I try to make my desserts low carb friendly. I enjoy reading, but these days it’s mainly children’s books. I take pride in my bargain shopping abilities. I love going up north to Boulder Junction and spending quality time with my family, friends, and all the dogs.

item.title: Katie
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Patient Care Coordinator

I was born and raised in Madison, WI. I started my dental career in a west side dental office in 2000 as an accounts/office manager. I feel very privileged to have been hired by Artisan Dental, and feel I have become part of a great team.  I have been married to my husband for over 20 yrs, and have two grown sons and 3 beautiful grandchildren. In my free time I love spending time with family and friends. In the summer I love to play golf and take long rides in our convertible.

item.title: Full & Partial Mouth Rehabilitation
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Look your very best!

Have You Considered A Partial or Full Mouth Restoration?

People choose to restore their smile to assist with a variety of challenges including those outlined below. If you have any of these common issues and would like to explore enhancing your smile, it would be Dr. Andersen’s pleasure to help you!

Schedule Your Consultation Learn More
We Can Fix These

Common Issues

Stabilize Bite

Relieve Pain

Injured/Damaged Teeth

Jaw Pain

Jaw Misalignment

Migraines

Crooked Teeth

Gaps in Teeth

Crowded Teeth

Missing Teeth

Misshapen Teeth

Length/Proportions

Chipped Teeth

Cracked Teeth

Stained Teeth

Don't Wait For Any Longer

Feel Your Very Best!

Enhance the level of comfort and confidence you have in your smile at work, at home and with friends.

Feel Your Best

Enhance the level of comfort and confidence you have in your smile at work, at home and with friends.

Enhance the Beauty of Your Smile

Upgrade and refine the shape, color, brightness and proportions of your teeth to an aesthetic you desire.

Relieve Pain and Stabilize Your Bite

Teeth can become injured, worn and weakened by a misalignment as they come together during the chewing process. Partial or Full-Mouth Restoration can correct this, reducing or eliminating pain and prolonging the life of your teeth.

Strengthen Your Teeth

Partial and Full-Mouth Restoration can include the restoration of your oral health using veneers, dental implants, crowns, Invisalign and the most contemporary techniques and materials.

Speak More Clearly

When teeth are missing, broken, chipped or dentures are improperly fitted, speaking can become a challenge. With a partial or Full-Mouth Restoration, the natural shape of your mouth can be restored, enabling you to more easily communicate with those around you.

Chew Better

It’s often difficult to chew when your teeth are misaligned or missing. By restoring and aligning your teeth, you can eat without pain or discomfort and enjoy your favorite foods again.

Stop Bone Loss and Decay

Damaged or missing teeth can affect your overall oral health. When teeth are missing or decayed, there is a risk of bone loss. By replacing teeth with a dental implant, veneers or crowns, you are stabilizing your oral health and jaw bone, enabling you to maintain your facial structure around the mouth and setting the stage for oral health in the future.

Meet Dr. Andersen

Warm, friendly, compassionate

Restore Your Smile and Improve Your Quality of Life with a Partial or Full-Mouth Restoration

Dr. Nicole Andersen’s passion is for changing someone’s life by making them comfortable and confident with one of their most important assets—a beautiful smile. A Full-Mouth Restoration can return decayed, cracked or damaged teeth to full health and function and allow you to smile again with confidence.

Dr. Andersen provides comprehensive dental services and has the skills necessary to make your full-mouth restoration a success. She is experienced in handling extensive cases and partners with one of the country’s best aesthetic dental labs to make sure the work you have done is not only strong and durable, but also looks aesthetic and natural.

Dr. Andersen has completed hundreds of hours of continuing education in full-mouth treatment with specialized, hands on training in the various fields of dental care, including Cosmetic Dentistry, with some of the world’s most qualified professors and instructors. You can learn more about Dr. Andersen’s training as an expert dentist by visiting her biography.

Dr. Andersen takes the time to completely understand the patient’s vision, goals and dreams for their smile. She understands that aesthetics are an important part of dental work and she loves helping patients look their best. She will take great care to ensure that you have a beautiful smile that is natural-looking and long-lasting.

Meet Dr. Andersen
Partial and Full Mouth Restoration

In Just 4 Simple Steps:

Your smile is unique, which means we will create a customized treatment plan designed around your vision and goals for your new smile. The process entails three easy steps.

Complimentary Restoration Consultation

Take advantage of our Complimentary Full-Mouth Restoration Consultation to meet Dr. Andersen and begin your dental restoration journey. 

Step #1

Understanding You and Your Goals

Time is created for Dr. Andersen to perform a comprehensive exam of your overall oral health. Dr. Andersen will review your historical treatment records and X-rays. She will also take photographs that will assist in the creation of dental models of your teeth. Dr. Andersen will then listen to your needs, wishes and goals regarding what you hope to see and experience when your smile is complete.

Step #2

Review Your Individualized Treatment Plan

Dr. Andersen will combine your dental history and personal goals to formulate an individualized treatment plan. The plan brings together suggestions to foster your overall oral health and aesthetic preferences, leading to increased levels of confidence in your new smile.

Step #3

Partial or Full-Mouth Restoration Preparation

After you approve the final design for your smile Dr. Andersen will complete the tooth preparation.

Step #4

Partial or Full-Mouth Restoration Completion

Your final few visits will include Dr. Andersen fitting and bonding your veneers or crowns to your teeth, along with any final gum sculpting. Steps 3 and 4 are comfortable with a range of spa-like amenities for your enjoyment and ease. The final outcome is a beautiful, healthy smile for years to come.

https://youtu.be/UfEpLime4ywhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fh6IQb8i6Sc
We have felixble payment options.

COMPLIMENTARY RESTORATION CONSULTATION

We provide complimentary consultations, where you have the opportunity to meet Dr. Andersen. During the complimentary consultation, she will recommend cosmetic dental approaches designed to help you achieve your vision and goals. Dr. Andersen will then provide an outline of the next steps in the process.

Once your treatment plan is complete, our patient care coordinators will work with you to identify any dental insurance coverage you may have for the procedures. We will also review any discounts available through the Artisan Dental Health Plan or payment the day of services. Lastly, we work closely with affiliated third-party financial partner, CareCredit to create affordable payment options.

View Payment Options

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in realizing your smile restoration goals.

Call or email to schedule your appointment with Dr. Andersen and review your smile design goals.

Schedule Your Consultation Call 608-467-8022

Full-Mouth Rehabilitation Procedures

A Full-Mouth Rehabilitation can consist of one or more procedures. Damaged or decayed teeth can be restored with crowns or repaired with root canals and missing teeth can be replaced with dental implants, bridges or partial dentures. Treatment may also involve veneers or dental bonding to improve the color and shape of existing teeth. Whatever procedure you need, Dr. Andersen can provide it. Your new smile can include:

Porcelain Veneers

Porcelain Veneers are thin porcelain coverings that are bonded to the front of your teeth to change their shape, size and/or color. Porcelain Veneers can usually be completed in two visits and can make a dramatic change to your smile.

Dental Crowns

A dental crown is used when the tooth needs cosmetic changes but is also in need of structural repair. A crown can also be used on top of an implant post to replace a missing tooth.

Dental Bridges

A dental bridge is a series of connected crowns that is used to replace one or more missing teeth. Although they have certain disadvantages compared to implants, bridges are a suitable option for replacing missing teeth in certain circumstances.

Dental Bonding

Dental bonding is a tooth-colored dental resin that can be used to correct flaws such as chips and minor cracks in a tooth. It can also be used to change the size, shape or color of your teeth, but is not as durable and long-lasting as veneers.

Laser Gum Sculpting for a Gummy Smile or Uneven Gum Line

Uneven gumlines and gums that are too large around your teeth can cause your smile to look unattractive and in some cases can affect your overall oral health. For most gum reshaping procedures the doctor uses a dental laser as a minimally-invasive way to sculpt the gum tissue.

Invisalign & SureSmile® Teeth Straightening

Effective clear aligner treatment designed to fit your lifestyle. Clear aligners are designed to orchestrate each step of your smile transformation with precision.

Dental Implants

Dental implants are considered the modern solution for replacing missing teeth. A titanium post is inserted into your jaw and topped by a crown which acts, looks and feels just like a natural tooth. We are usually able to provide all stages of your implant treatment in-house.

Dr. Nicole Andersen\u2019s passion is for changing someone\u2019s life by making them comfortable and confident with one of their most important assets\u2014a beautiful smile. A Full-Mouth Restoration can return decayed, cracked or damaged teeth to full health and function and allow you to smile again with confidence.<\/p>\n

Dr. Andersen provides comprehensive dental services and has the skills necessary to make your full-mouth restoration a success. She is experienced in handling extensive cases and partners with one of the country\u2019s best aesthetic dental labs to make sure the work you have done is not only strong and durable, but also looks aesthetic and natural.<\/p>\n

Dr. Andersen has completed hundreds of hours of continuing education in full-mouth treatment with specialized, hands on training in the various fields of dental care, including Cosmetic Dentistry, with some of the world\u2019s most qualified professors and instructors. You can learn more about Dr. Andersen\u2019s training as an expert dentist by visiting her biography.<\/a><\/p>\n

Dr. Andersen takes the time to completely understand the patient\u2019s vision, goals and dreams for their smile. She understands that aesthetics are an important part of dental work and she loves helping patients look their best. Feel Your Best

Enhance the level of comfort and confidence you have in your smile at work, at home and with friends.

Enhance the Beauty of Your Smile

Upgrade and refine the shape, color, brightness and proportions of your teeth to an aesthetic you desire.

Relieve Pain and Stabilize Your Bite

Teeth can become injured, worn and weakened by a misalignment as they come together during the chewing process. Partial or Full-Mouth Restoration can correct this, reducing or eliminating pain and prolonging the life of your teeth.

Strengthen Your Teeth

Partial and Full-Mouth Restoration can include the restoration of your oral health using veneers, dental implants, crowns, Invisalign and the most contemporary techniques and materials.

Speak More Clearly

When teeth are missing, broken, chipped or dentures are improperly fitted, speaking can become a challenge. With a partial or Full-Mouth Restoration, the natural shape of your mouth can be restored, enabling you to more easily communicate with those around you.

Chew Better

It’s often difficult to chew when your teeth are misaligned or missing. By restoring and aligning your teeth, you can eat without pain or discomfort and enjoy your favorite foods again.

Stop Bone Loss and Decay

Damaged or missing teeth can affect your overall oral health. When teeth are missing or decayed, there is a risk of bone loss. By replacing teeth with a dental implant, veneers or crowns, you are stabilizing your oral health and jaw bone, enabling you to maintain your facial structure around the mouth and setting the stage for oral health in the future.

We provide complimentary consultations, where you have the opportunity to meet Dr. Andersen. Once your treatment plan is complete, our patient care coordinators will work with you to identify any dental insurance coverage you may have for the procedures. We will also review any discounts available through the Artisan Dental Health Plan or payment the day of services. Full-Mouth Rehabilitation Procedures

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]

Porcelain Veneers

Porcelain Veneers are thin porcelain coverings that are bonded to the front of your teeth to change their shape, size and/or color. Porcelain Veneers can usually be completed in two visits and can make a dramatic change to your smile.

Dental Crowns

A dental crown is used when the tooth needs cosmetic changes but is also in need of structural repair. A crown can also be used on top of an implant post to replace a missing tooth.

Dental Bridges

A dental bridge is a series of connected crowns that is used to replace one or more missing teeth. Although they have certain disadvantages compared to implants, bridges are a suitable option for replacing missing teeth in certain circumstances.

Dental Bonding

Dental bonding is a tooth-colored dental resin that can be used to correct flaws such as chips and minor cracks in a tooth. It can also be used to change the size, shape or color of your teeth, but is not as durable and long-lasting as veneers.

Laser Gum Sculpting for a Gummy Smile or Uneven Gum Line

Uneven gumlines and gums that are too large around your teeth can cause your smile to look unattractive and in some cases can affect your overall oral health. For most gum reshaping procedures the doctor uses a dental laser as a minimally-invasive way to sculpt the gum tissue.

Invisalign & SureSmile® Teeth Straightening

Effective clear aligner treatment designed to fit your lifestyle. Clear aligners are designed to orchestrate each step of your smile transformation with precision.

Dental Implants

Dental implants are considered the modern solution for replacing missing teeth. A titanium post is inserted into your jaw and topped by a crown which acts, looks and feels just like a natural tooth. We are usually able to provide all stages of your implant treatment in-house.

item.title: Dental Implants
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

Modern medical science has created a whole new paradigm for life expectancy. What was once thought to be middle-aged now represents the prime of our life. As a result, we’re using our teeth longer, and dental health is more important than ever. A routine of flossing, brushing, and using mouthwash is enough to keep our teeth healthy most of the time. However, whether through accidents, medical conditions, or poor oral hygiene, we can still lose our teeth. Finding new restoration treatments that help us keep a beautiful, functional smile for a lifetime is more important than ever. Dental implants are the rising star of dental restorations and are the go-to option for many dentists and patients.

Understanding Implants And Why They Do Wonders For Lasting Oral Function

Dental implants are a popular form of dental restoration that provides superior appearance and function over previous options. Using a titanium mounting screw set into the jawbone, and a  dental prosthetic known as a crown, your smile can be restored. Titanium does more than provide a stable mounting surface. This metal is known for its ability to stimulate bone growth. Through a process known as osseointegration, this metal combines with the implant and integrates the implant to the bone, much like your previous tooth. This integration is just one of the advantages implants have over dentures.

This list isn’t where the benefits end, however. Dental implants are also more stable and long-lasting than dentures. They can last for decades without losing functionality or appearance. Convenience is another significant edge they have over dentures. Traditional dentures are taken out every night to be cleaned and sanitized. Dental implants remain in place and are cared for much like your natural teeth.

Those most likely to benefit from dental implants include patients who:

  • Have good oral health and hygiene practices
  • Don’t use tobacco products or vape
  • Those who have dense, healthy jawbones
  • Don’t have gingivitis or periodontitis

 

Implants are a very versatile solution to tooth replacement. Your dentist can use them to replace a single tooth or multiple teeth. They can also use them to replace an entire arch of teeth using only a few mounting points in the jaw. Expandability is another option; your dentist can use previously placed mounts to facilitate multiple tooth solutions.

Caring for your implants is simple and already part of your standard hygiene practices. You need to continue brushing, flossing, and using a water pik. These standard hygiene practices, combined with a bi-annual visit to your dentist for a checkup, are all that’s required.

Learn More By Calling Artisan Dental In Madison, WI Today

Our team in Madison, WI, is ready to receive new and existing patients seeking dental implants. By scheduling a consultation visit, you’ll set yourself on the road to a beautiful and functioning smile. During your visit, you’ll undergo a thorough dental exam, discuss your medical history, and explore options for dental restorations with our team. Don’t let a missing tooth or teeth spell the end to a confident smile. Call us today!

Using a titanium mounting screw set into the jawbone, and a  dental prosthetic known as a crown, your smile can be restored. Titanium does more than provide a stable mounting surface. This metal is known for its ability to stimulate bone growth. Through a process known as osseointegration, this metal combines with the implant and integrates the implant to the bone, much like your previous tooth. This integration is just one of the advantages implants have over dentures.

This list isn’t where the benefits end, however. Dental implants are also more stable and long-lasting than dentures. They can last for decades without losing functionality or appearance. Convenience is another significant edge they have over dentures. Traditional dentures are taken out every night to be cleaned and sanitized. Dental implants remain in place and are cared for much like your natural teeth.

Those most likely to benefit from dental implants include patients who:

  • Have good oral health and hygiene practices
  • Don’t use tobacco products or vape
  • Those who have dense, healthy jawbones
  • Don’t have gingivitis or periodontitis

 

Implants are a very versatile solution to tooth replacement. Your dentist can use them to replace a single tooth or multiple teeth. They can also use them to replace an entire arch of teeth using only a few mounting points in the jaw. Expandability is another option; your dentist can use previously placed mounts to facilitate multiple tooth solutions.

Caring for your implants is simple and already part of your standard hygiene practices. You need to continue brushing, flossing, and using a water pik. These standard hygiene practices, combined with a bi-annual visit to your dentist for a checkup, are all that’s required.

item.title: Same-Day Crowns (CEREC)
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

CEREC has changed the way dentists perform patient restorations. CEREC stands for ‘ceramic reconstruction.’ It’s a 3D imaging and camera assisted design center that allows dentists to take digital impressions of patient teeth and use the images to create a virtual restoration. The images can be sent to a dental laboratory for fabrication or combined with an in-office milling unit for same-day restorations. CEREC can be used to produce onlays, inlays, crowns or bridges without taking molded impressions.

 

Watch this quick video!

Did you know?

That CEREC is a German technology that was first developed more than 30 years ago? Today, CEREC is setting new standards in dentistry and constantly evolving to adapt to the demands of dentists and their patients. When you choose a dentist specializing in CEREC assisted restorations, you are choosing a dentist who is dedicated to accuracy, efficiency, and durability.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I benefit from CEREC?

Absolutely! CEREC can help anyone who needs an inlay, onlay, crown, bridge or even veneers. It takes only seconds to get accurate and detailed images of your teeth.

What should I expect from a CEREC dentist?

CEREC takes only seconds to obtain digital images. Your dentist will then use CEREC’s CAD/CAM technology to virtually design a restoration. The amount of time this takes depends on your dentist’s skill and experience using CEREC, as well as the complexity of your restoration.

What are the long-term results with CEREC?

Following the placement of a crown or other restoration, you may feel some sensitivity for a few days. Though exact experiences vary from patient to patient, you can expect a crown produced using CEREC technology to last you many years so long as you use good oral hygiene and are not grinding your teeth.

item.title: Extractions
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

Tooth extractions are routine dental procedures used to remove decayed, damaged, or otherwise problematic teeth. Dentists usually make every effort to preserve natural teeth, although sometimes an extraction is necessary. Although the procedure is performed in a dentist’s or oral surgeon’s office, it is considered surgery. Depending on which teeth are removed, they may be replaced with a dental implant or another oral prosthetic.

 

There are several reasons why you could need a tooth extraction.

The most common cause of tooth extractions is severe tooth decay and cavities. However, many patients also undergo extractions for impacted teeth – particularly wisdom teeth. Other causes for extraction include advanced periodontal disease, cracked teeth, and teeth that are severely malformed. Although many circumstances that require extraction are unavoidable, some could be prevented with regular visits to your dentist for exams and cleanings.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a tooth extraction?

Only your dentist can tell you if you need a tooth extraction. However, you may be a candidate for the procedure if one or more of your teeth are decayed so severely that a filling or other restoration is not a possibility for treatment.

What should I expect during my tooth extraction appointment?

If you and your dentist decide to extract one or more teeth, you will be scheduled to return for oral surgery at a later date. You will be given a local anesthetic to prevent pain during the procedure, and you may be prescribed medications to help manage pain in the hours following your extraction.

What type of post-treatment care will I need to follow?

Post-operative care following a tooth extraction is essential for healing and preventing complications. You will be instructed to avoid certain foods and also to keep the surgical site clean at all times. If you are prescribed an antibiotic, it is important that you complete the course of treatment to prevent infection. Finally, you may be advised to avoid smoking or drinking through a straw, as doing so may delay the healing process and cause a condition known as ‘dry socket.’

item.title: Endodontic (Root Canal)
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

At our office in Madison, WI, Artisan Dental strives to provide full-scale dental services to our community. This goal means treating all aspects of oral health, from gum disease and decay to endodontic services. Endodontic is a term that refers to the interior (Endo) of the tooth (dontic). We ensure our patient family experiences quality care without the inconvenience of having to visit multiple offices.

Understanding Endodontics: Root Canal Therapy and Beyond

With a focus on the tooth's interior, endodontic care primarily concerns itself with the health of your dental pulp. Your dental pulp exists both within the core of your crown and within the roots of your teeth. These roots contain multiple narrow, twisty passageways known as root canals.

ENDODONTICS (ROOT CANAL THERAPY)

The first goal of any dentist is to preserve as much natural dental tissue as possible. When infection attacks your dental pulp, antibiotics aren't usually able to stop it. Without eliminating this infection, the tooth would have to be removed. Root canal therapy allows our team to remove the infection and save the tooth. While the dental pulp is essential during the development of your teeth, adult teeth can survive without it. Your remaining dentin and enamel are preserved by eliminating the infected pulp and replacing it with a biocompatible material. The majority of teeth have between one and four root canals, though extra canals can be found in many molars.

ENDODONTIC RETREATMENT

When new issues occur in a tooth that has undergone root canal therapy, retreatment may be necessary. This concern can result from an injury, the seal coming loose, or an infected accessory canal. The accessory canals mentioned above can often be challenging to detect and are different in every patient. Retreatment can address this issue and save the tooth.

Learn More About Endodontic Services Available At Artisan Dental

These are the most common endodontic procedures that we perform. If you're experiencing dental pain, it's time to schedule a visit to our Madison, WI offices. Our team will bring you in, perform a complete dental exam, and provide options to treat your discomfort. With their help, you'll be able to locate and address the source of your pain and preserve your beautiful smile. Please don't wait until it's too late to save your tooth. Call today and find out if endodontic treatment is proper for you!

There’s more to your oral health than dental enamel and gums. Inside your teeth are vital tissues that can become infected and need care with endodontics.

item.title: Invisalign® & SureSmile® Clear Teeth Straightening in Madison
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Invisalign® & SureSmile® Clear Teeth Straightening in Madison

Invisalign & SureSmile clear aligners straighten teeth as effectively as traditional braces – without metal brackets and sharp wires!

Beautiful, straight teeth without metal braces

Invisalign and SureSmile are systems of virtually invisible teeth straightening, using clear plastic aligners that fit snugly over your teeth and are suitable for adults and teenagers whose permanent teeth have fully erupted.

Teeth straightening can improve your smile and bite significantly, but the prospect of wearing traditional braces can be daunting. The metal brackets that come with traditional braces are uncomfortable and conspicuous and they also make your teeth difficult to clean, which can lead to complications during and after your treatment.

With Invisalign and SureSmile you can straighten your teeth and get that beautiful smile without wearing unattractive metal braces. Invisalign and SureSmile “aligners” are removable, so you can eat anything you want, as well as brush and floss easily.

Experienced Invisalign® and SureSmile® Providers

At Artisan Dental, our doctors have more than 15 years of combined experience in providing Invisalign and SureSmile to patients. Each is an experienced Invisalign and SureSmile practitioner and as with all our dental care, we give skilled, friendly and personalized treatment, making sure that your new smile matches your expectations.

Invisalign and SureSmile Consultation

Our dentist are happy to offer an evaluation of your oral health to help determine if you are a candidate for invisalign or sure smile and to get your questions answered.

  • Consultation with the doctor
  • Learn about Invisalign or SureSmile treatment
  • Find out if Invisalign or SureSmile is right for you
  • Get all your questions answered

To make an appointment, call 608-467-8022 or click here to request an appointment online.

Advantages of Invisalign® and SureSmile® over traditional metal braces

There are numerous advantages of using Invisalign® or SureSmile® for your teeth straightening, including:

  • They are virtually invisible, so most people won’t notice you’re straightening your teeth
  • You can take them out to eat, so there’s no worry about food restrictions or getting food stuck in them
  • There’s no sharp or uncomfortable metal in your mouth, no wires or rubber bands
  • They are unnoticeable when laughing, talking or eating with other people
  • It’s easy to keep your teeth and gums healthy – simply pop the aligner out to brush and floss
https://youtu.be/2WcU_cbD7Vkhttps://youtu.be/DKuc8WTQ3yMhttps://youtu.be/qXz5af8FjSohttps://youtu.be/whinv3O79c8https://youtu.be/DKuc8WTQ3yM

How Invisalign and SureSmile Work

Invisalign treatment for adults usually takes about 12 months, about the same amount of time as braces. With SureSmile, you can often reduce that time to approximately 6 months. Because the aligners can be removed at any time such as for special occasions or prior to eating meals, they have a minimum impact on your lifestyle. Invisalign and SureSmile fit well into your busy adult schedule as there are no frequent visits for wire tightening. You simply change aligners every two weeks and can see the positive changes as you go.

At the completion of each SureSmile treatment, we offer free full-mouth teeth whitening.

Conditions Artisan Dental Can Fix with Invisalign & SureSmile

Invisalign and SureSmile treatment can fix a wide variety of problems with teeth and bite alignment, from mild cases of crooked teeth to much more difficult problems involving serious bite issues.

Here are some of the main conditions Artisan Dental can fix with Invisalign or SureSmile:

Overly crowded

When teeth are crowded in the mouth, it can be difficult to clean the teeth properly. This can promote tooth decay and cause a higher risk of gum disease.

Overbite

An overbite can cause excessive wear on the lower teeth, gum irritation and can also cause jaw problems.

Underbite

This occurs when the bottom teeth protrude beyond the upper teeth and can interfere with the normal function of front teeth and molars, and can lead to jaw problems.

Gaps in Teeth

Gaps can trap food and bacteria and lead to tooth decay and gum disease. It can also cause teeth to shift into the empty spaces and increase misalignment.

Open Bite

An open bite can interfere with chewing and can cause speech impairment and jaw problems.

Crossbite

This is a symptom of jaw misalignment, which can cause worn-down teeth, gum disease or both.

To make an appointment, call 608-467-8022 or click here to request an appointment online.

There are numerous advantages of using Invisalign® or SureSmile® for your teeth straightening, including:

  • They are virtually invisible, so most people won’t notice you’re straightening your teeth
  • You can take them out to eat, so there’s no worry about food restrictions or getting food stuck in them
  • There’s no sharp or uncomfortable metal in your mouth, no wires or rubber bands
  • They are unnoticeable when laughing, talking or eating with other people
  • It’s easy to keep your teeth and gums healthy – simply pop the aligner out to brush and floss

Invisalign treatment for adults usually takes about 12 months, about the same amount of time as braces. With SureSmile, you can often reduce that time to approximately 6 months. Because the aligners can be removed at any time such as for special occasions or prior to eating meals, they have a minimum impact on your lifestyle. Invisalign and SureSmile fit well into your busy adult schedule as there are no frequent visits for wire tightening. You simply change aligners every two weeks and can see the positive changes as you go.

At the completion of each SureSmile treatment, we offer free full-mouth teeth whitening.

Conditions Artisan Dental Can Fix with Invisalign & SureSmile

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]

Overly crowded

When teeth are crowded in the mouth, it can be difficult to clean the teeth properly. This can promote tooth decay and cause a higher risk of gum disease.

Overbite

An overbite can cause excessive wear on the lower teeth, gum irritation and can also cause jaw problems.

Underbite

This occurs when the bottom teeth protrude beyond the upper teeth and can interfere with the normal function of front teeth and molars, and can lead to jaw problems.

Gaps in Teeth

Gaps can trap food and bacteria and lead to tooth decay and gum disease. It can also cause teeth to shift into the empty spaces and increase misalignment.

Open Bite

An open bite can interfere with chewing and can cause speech impairment and jaw problems.

Crossbite

This is a symptom of jaw misalignment, which can cause worn-down teeth, gum disease or both.
