item.title: Ceramic or Porcelain Veneers
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
A Beautiful New Smile With Natural-Looking Veneers

A veneer is a thin ceramic or porcelain facing that covers the front of your tooth, changing its size, shape or color. Veneers can solve cosmetic concerns, such as cracked or chipped teeth, small gaps between your teeth, slightly crooked or misaligned teeth, small or poorly shaped teeth or teeth that are resistant to whitening agents. If you have been unhappy with the appearance of your smile, veneers could be the answer you’ve been looking for.

Dr. Andersen is an experienced cosmetic dentist with extensive training in the aesthetic aspects of dentistry. Making smiles look better is a central part of her approach to dentistry, and she puts great care into improving the appearance of her patients’ smiles. She has perfected her planning and preparation for veneers over the years so that she is able to obtain beautiful, natural-looking results.

Veneers can also help lengthen the shape of teeth and serve as an alternative to braces.

Premier dental lab for top-quality results

For the best quality in veneers, Artisan Dental partners with one of the country’s best aesthetic dental labs. Our lab provides superior veneers made from top-quality porcelain with a very beautiful and lifelike appearance. Ceramic veneers are created by a master ceramist and can take one to three weeks to craft. During this time, Dr. Andersen provides you with temporary veneers to wear, which provide a beautiful smile until your permanent veneers are ready to be placed.

What Can Be Accomplished With Porcelain Veneers?

Many problems with your teeth can be solved with porcelain veneers:

  • Restoring worn or chipped teeth
  • Fixing stained or discolored teeth, including those with tetracycline staining
  • Closing spaces between teeth
  • Lengthening teeth
  • As an alternative to braces

Your Route To A Beautiful New Smile

Designing your smile

Your new smile design starts with external photos of your face and smile, at all angles. We take impressions of your teeth and prepare an exact model that mimics both the appearance and function of your teeth and gums.

Digital representations are used to provide an example of how your new teeth will look.

The new smile is designed using the photos and the model of your teeth. Before creating your veneers, Dr. Andersen will show you how your new smile will look on a digital representation. Any changes you want will be made, and once you are completely satisfied, detailed instructions are sent to our high-quality cosmetic lab to fabricate the veneers.

Ceramic Veneers

In Just 4 Simple Steps:

Your smile is unique, which means we will create a customized treatment plan designed around your goals and visions for your new smile. The process entails four easy steps.

Complimentary Cosmetic Consultation

Take advantage of our Complimentary Cosmetic Consultation to meet Dr. Andersen and begin your smile design process. 

Step #1

Understanding You and Your Goals

Time is created for Dr. Andersen to perform a comprehensive exam of your overall oral health.  Dr. Andersen will review your historical treatment records and X-rays.  She will also take photographs that will assist in the creation of dental models of your teeth.  Dr. Andersen will then listen to your needs, wishes and goals regarding what you hope to see and experience when your smile is complete.

Step #2

Review Your Individualized Treatment Plan

Dr. Andersen will combine your overall oral health and aesthetic preferences to formulate an individualized treatment plan.  The plan brings together suggestions to foster your overall oral health and aesthetic preferences, leading to increased levels of confidence in your new smile.

Step #3

Smile Design Preparation

After you approve the final design for your smile,  Dr. Andersen will complete the tooth preparation work.

Step #4

Smile Design Completion

Your final visits will include Dr. Andersen fitting and bonding your veneers or crowns to your teeth, along with any final gum sculpting.  Steps 3 and 4 are comfortable with a range of spa-like amenities for your enjoyment and ease. The final outcome is a beautiful, healthy smile for years to come.

Skilled Cosmetic Dentist

Dr. Nicole Andersen’s passion for changing someone’s life by making them comfortable and confident with one of their most important assets—a beautiful smile—shows in the extensive cosmetic dentistry she has performed over the last 15 years. Patients have come from all over the area to take advantage of Dr. Anderson’s skill and expertise in cosmetic dentistry.

Dr. Andersen is committed to exceptional, quality care and aesthetically-beautiful outcomes which results from her hundreds of hours of specialized, hands-on training in cosmetic dental care with some of the worlds most qualified professors and instructors. You can learn more about Dr. Andersen’s training as an expert cosmetic dentist by visiting her biography.

Dr. Andersen understands that aesthetics are an important part of dental work and she loves helping patients look their best. She will take great care to ensure that you have a beautiful smile that is natural-looking and long-lasting.

View Doctor Bio
A New Smile Design

Complimentary Cosmetic Consultation

We provide complimentary consultations, where you have the opportunity to meet Dr. Andersen. During the complimentary consultation, she will recommend cosmetic dental approaches designed to help you achieve your smile goals. Dr. Andersen will then provide an outline of the next steps in the process.

Once your treatment plan is complete, our patient care coordinators will work with you to identify any dental insurance coverage you may have for the procedures. We will also review discounts available through the Artisan Dental Health Plan or payment the day of services. Lastly, we work closely with affiliated third-party financial partner, CareCredit to create affordable payment options.

Dr. Andersen is an experienced cosmetic dentist with extensive training in the aesthetic aspects of dentistry. Making smiles look better is a central part of her approach to dentistry, and she puts great care into improving the appearance of her patients’ smiles. Veneers can also help lengthen the shape of teeth and serve as an alternative to braces.

Your new smile design starts with external photos of your face and smile, at all angles. We take impressions of your teeth and prepare an exact model that mimics both the appearance and function of your teeth and gums.

Digital representations are used to provide an example of how your new teeth will look.

The new smile is designed using the photos and the model of your teeth. Before creating your veneers, Dr. Andersen will show you how your new smile will look on a digital representation. Any changes you want will be made, and once you are completely satisfied, detailed instructions are sent to our high-quality cosmetic lab to fabricate the veneers.

Dr. Nicole Andersen’s passion for changing someone’s life by making them comfortable and confident with one of their most important assets—a beautiful smile—shows in the extensive cosmetic dentistry she has performed over the last 15 years. Patients have come from all over the area to take advantage of Dr. Anderson’s skill and expertise in cosmetic dentistry.

Dr. Andersen is committed to exceptional, quality care and aesthetically-beautiful outcomes which results from her hundreds of hours of specialized, hands-on training in cosmetic dental care with some of the worlds most qualified professors and instructors. You can learn more about Dr. Andersen’s training as an expert cosmetic dentist by visiting her biography.

Dr. Andersen understands that aesthetics are an important part of dental work and she loves helping patients look their best. She will take great care to ensure that you have a beautiful smile that is natural-looking and long-lasting.

item.title: Laser Gum Sculpting
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

Our gum tissues provide our teeth the protection they need from bacteria and food debris, protecting us from tooth decay and jaw degradation. However, sometimes those gums can overpower the appearance of your smile. Often referred to as a “gummy smile,” having too much gum show along the gum line can appear excessive. At Artisan Dental, we provide laser gum sculpting to correct this issue and help improve the appearance of your smile. By removing excess tissues from your mouth, your smile will look and feel healthier.

Why Receive Laser Gum Sculpting Treatment

Laser gum sculpting, also referred to as gum contouring or gingival sculpting, removes excess gum tissue by surgically trimming it through the use of lasers. The lasers work to make precise cuts to the gum line rather than the use of scalpels. For patients, this means that their smiles can be dramatically improved while decreasing the risk of scarring along the gum line. For many, laser gum reshaping can be included in smile makeovers, where dentists work to reshape the mouth completely to form a perfectly aligned, white, and beautiful smile.

No matter the reasons, our team at Artisan Dental will provide you with the tools you need to correct uneven gum lines, eliminate excess gum tissue, and improve your smile and overall appearance. When receiving treatment from our practice, we perform the following to make sure you have a safe and effective treatment:

  • Dental Examination: During your dental examination, we will discuss your treatment options for your gummy smile. By observing your medical history, we can ultimately determine your candidacy for treatment.
  • Scheduled Appointment: For patients who qualify for gum reshaping, our office will discuss financing options during your examination and schedule an appointment ahead of time for the procedure.
  • Numbing Agents: During the procedure, our dentists will use numbing agents and local anesthesia to protect the gums and teeth from any pain sensations to prepare for the procedure.
  • Laser Treatment: Once the numbing agents set in, our dentists will surgically remove sections of the gum line using state-of-the-art lasers and reshape the remaining gums back along the tooth line.
  • Aftercare and Maintenance: Once completed, our team will inform you of any aftercare instructions for your gums to help the healing process and schedule follow-up appointments.
 

Any significant amount of gum recession may require the use of soft tissue grafts to restore the gum line, and these grafts can help reshape the smile back to an aesthetically pleasing appearance.

Choose Artisan Dental For Laser Gum Treatment

As laser treatments for gum reshaping have become the subject of ongoing study, our dental practice focuses on providing you with safe, effective care to improve your oral health and keep your smile healthy. If you have a gum line that appears puffy, large, and unattractive, visit our office in Madison, Wisconsin, to learn more about our treatment options. Our team is here for you to help improve your oral care and give you healthy, happy teeth.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Pain-free Gum Contouring With Laser Technology in Madison WI
Patients in Madison, WI can eliminate gummy smiles with laser gum sculpting from Artisan Dental. It’s painless, quick, and has the shortest recovery times.

item.title: Teeth Whitening Options
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Teeth Whitening Options:

We understand that even with over-the-counter options, certain shades and discolorations of teeth can be just too stubborn to lighten. That's why we offer teeth whitening for our patients! Our teeth whitening services will help remove stains, discoloration, and signs of yellowing teeth and provide you with the confidence boost you need for a healthy smile. Under the care of our team at Artisan Dental, we can provide affordable treatment options to remove stains and help you have a beautiful white smile.

What You Should Know About Teeth Whitening

Discoloration can be an unappealing part of your smile, but know that we're here to help. Professional teeth whitening works to lighten this discoloration through the use of hydrogen peroxide. While many over-the-counter options have this mixture in their products, professional whitening services offer a higher percentage of hydrogen peroxide than over the counter whiteners. When used with custom trays, the whitening gel applies evenly precisely to your specific smile. During your dental exam with us, we work with you to understand the source of your discoloration. Tooth discoloration can often happen for a number of reasons, but we classify discoloration into different types depending on the source of the stain, the deepness of the stain, and other factors related to your oral health. These classifications include: 
  • Extrinsic: These types of stains often come from culprits such as tea, coffee, wine, and poor dental hygiene. Extrinsic stains only affect the enamel surface and are usually removable through both at-home treatments and professional cleanings. 
  • Intrinsic: Over time, however, extrinsic stains can become intrinsic. Intrinsic stains are  embedded into the enamel and are best treated by a professional whitening system. 
  • Age-Related Stains: Other stains can be caused by other factors not controlled by your oral habits. Aging is often one of the biggest proponents of yellowing stains. 
Teeth whitening is considered safe and can be a great cosmetic option for you to help you achieve a better-looking smile. 

How Artisan Dental Can Help With Teeth Whitening

Our professional teeth whitening services can help keep your smile gleaming and bright. During your exam, we will work with you to provide treatment plans, schedule appointments, discuss financing options and other preventative measures to keep your teeth clean and healthy. For more information about your discoloration and our treatments, schedule a dental visit at our practice in Madison, Wisconsin, to learn more about what we do at Artisan Dental.

Dental staining can be difficult to remove with over the counter options. See the benefits of professional whitening with the team at Artisan Dental.

item.title: Composite Tooth-Colored Fillings
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

Dental decay is the most common medical issue facing patients of all ages in the United States. With the prevalence of cavities in our population, fillings are a necessity to properly restore the tooth and prevent further destruction or tooth loss. For many years the most prominently used form of filling was called amalgam. The material used in these fillings contained a blend of metals to create a silvery alloy. Although these fillings can be long-lasting, many times they are a less conservative filling than the tooth-colored bonded fillings and less esthetic. 

The Benefits Of Tooth-Colored Fillings

The first and most noticeable reason for using this form of filling is their visual similarity to natural tooth material. The advantages they offer over amalgam fillings make them an excellent choice for restoring the appearance and function of your smile. These benefits have led to many patients choosing to replace their old amalgam fillings. Using composite resin, you can have a new restoration made or your old ones replaced in just one visit.

Tooth-colored fillings are created using a special resin that combines ceramic particles with dental plastic. This resin makes the material incredibly malleable during placement, ensuring that every part of the cavity is sealed against infection. It can bond directly with the structure of the tooth, forming a seamless fit and appearance to the tooth.

Other benefits of composite resin fillings include:

  • Resin can be custom contoured and colored to match natural teeth
  • Requires less healthy tooth to be removed to place them
  • Some can have fluoride integrated into the material to support deeper cavities
  • No concerns with metal allergies that some patients experience with amalgams
 

These alone are great reasons to take advantage of composite resins. There are also great reasons to replace existing amalgam fillings, such as:

  • Amalgam fillings have been shown to weaken the remaining dental tissues
  • Silver fillings can wear down with less seal to the healthy tooth causing leakage
  • The silver fillings have been shown to cause staining and discoloration of healthy tooth
  • Silver fillings are visually unappealing
 

Regardless of your reason for getting tooth-colored fillings, the process remains the same. Our team will begin by numbing the area to be treated. The next step is removing existing fillings or decayed dental tissue to prepare for the filling. The composite resin will then be color-matched to your dental enamel and put into place. Our team will finish by shaping and polishing the resin until it matches the shape of your tooth. When it’s all done, the restoration will be nearly invisible to the casual observer.

Schedule Your Restoration Visit With Artisan Dental In Madison, WI Today

Our team here at Artisan Dental is ready to help you restore functionality and beauty to your smile today! Contact our team, and we’ll prepare an appointment date for you with one of our specialists. We're excited to see you again or to welcome you to our dental patient family.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Composite Tooth-Colored Fillings in Madison, WI %sep% Artisan Dental
Amalgam fillings have ruled the roost for too long. Artisan Dental now offers composite resin fillings that match your natural tooth color.

item.title: Teeth Cleaning
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

At Artisan Dental, our team provides comprehensive treatment for individuals and families. When you make an appointment through us, we will care for all aspects of your oral health to help prevent the onset of dental issues such as cavities, gum disease, and other issues of the jaw and mouth. Our oral cleaning sessions can help identify problems beforehand, address those issues, and provide comprehensive treatment plans that prevent dental issues from becoming worse.

Why Choose Artisan Dental For Cleanings?

Artisan Dental has an excellent team of dentists, assistants, and hygienists that are dedicated to providing you with the highest level dental care. Under the direction of leading dentists, including Dr. Andersen, Dr. Dayal, Dr. Reimer, and Dr. Rehermann, our combined levels of experience and professionalism are here for you in whatever you need to keep your teeth and gums healthy.

Our regular cleanings are considered a vital part of our care because through these exams, we’re able to detect oral diseases early on and treat them effectively. Regular dental cleanings allow us to keep your mouth healthy and help us monitor all aspects of your oral health to the highest degree of care we can provide. During your dental exam, we work to understand all aspects of your health, including:

  • Your Medical History: During your exam and cleaning, we look at all aspects of your medical history, medications, and family history to discuss how they may be affecting your oral health and any oral disease you may have.
  • Your Dental History: Any previous dental work or undetected issues will be discussed with you during your cleaning to help us provide more comprehensive plans that work with you.
  • Habits and Lifestyle: Oral habits, including brushing and flossing, are an essential part of your oral care. We work to help provide better ease of access to dental services that can be better integrated into your lifestyle to improve your oral health.
  • Pricing and Treatments: Through discussing financing options and treatment plans, we provide personalized attention to the needs of our patients.

Our cleaning sessions at Artisan Dental can provide you with that clean feel you need for healthy teeth. This includes removing any signs of plaque and tartar, addressing bacteria along the gum line, observing signs of discoloration throughout the teeth, and assessing the health of your jawbone in relation to your tooth alignment. All this occurs just through regular cleaning with us!

Choose Artisan Dental in Madison, Wisconsin Today!

Having good oral hygiene is the backbone of a healthy smile. Our professional dental cleanings work to keep your mouth healthy long-term and ensure that you and your family have clean teeth free from plaque and food debris. For more information, contact our dental team to arrange an appointment and keep your teeth healthy for years to come. Through an appointment with us, our team members will discuss with you financing options, scheduling plans, and treatment options we have available to bring you the most out of your dental care.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Teeth Cleaning Treatment in Madison, WI | Artisan Dental
Artisan Dental provides patients in the Madison, WI area with beautiful smiles using the latest cosmetic and restorative treatments. Call us today.

item.title: Periodontal Therapy
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Information:

Gingivitis is faced by many people at some point in their lives and often can easily be treated with regular dental cleanings and consistent brushing. However, gingivitis can easily advance into periodontal disease, a disease that presents a severe risk to your gums and teeth. This advanced form can’t be eliminated independently and needs professional deep cleanings to fully remove the bacteria and plaque that accumulates around the gum line.

At Artisan Dental, we work with patients to help manage periodontal disease long-term through regular scheduled deep cleanings and other forms of dental maintenance. Our periodontal therapy services can help remove deep fissures of bacteria along the gum line and help keep your teeth clean overtime.

How We Work To Protect Against Periodontal Disease

Periodontal disease presents some of the biggest problems in oral care due to its persistent nature. As the bacteria film develops and embeds along the gum line, the bacteria easily infects below the gum line and into the jawbone. This can infect the jawbone and cause massive amounts of decay and lead to tooth decay, bone loss, and gum tissue degradation. Because of these side effects, the inflammation and irritation caused by this disease can make it difficult for patients to effectively clean their teeth and keep their teeth clean long term.

If you’ve been diagnosed with periodontal disease, our team at Artisan Dental is here to help. We will work with you to help remove the bacterial infection and keep it from returning through our effective periodontal therapy treatment plan. Through our plan, we will provide:

  • Regular Dental Exams: Our oral exams will provide you with an accurate diagnosis for your oral health and help determine the level and severity of periodontal disease present.
  • Scaling and Root Planing: Through numbing agents, scaling methods, and planing procedures, our dentists will work to eliminate the build-up of plaque and calculus from along and below the gum line to prevent further infection.  Scaling and root planing techniques may include an ultrasonic scaler, hand scaling and diode laser therapy.
  • Irrigation and Aftercare: Once completed, we will rinse your mouth and medicate the areas needed to further prevent the development of bacteria.
  • Maintenance and Retreatment: By practicing diligent oral practices and retreatments, we can help keep periodontal disease from returning.

Visits every three months may be required for those more prone to severe periodontal disease.

Why Visit Artisan Dental For Periodontal Therapy

Because of the severity of periodontal disease, our prevention methods work to help keep periodontal disease at bay from harming your oral and overall health long term. Through good oral practices and regular dental visits at Artisan Dental, patients with periodontal disease can find sufficient care through our team in Madison, Wisconsin. To learn about our health care plans for periodontal disease and other ways you can protect your teeth, arrange an appointment with our practice today.

Dental patients in Madison, WI can see the benefits of periodontal therapy in eliminating periodontitis and gingivitis. Call us for additional details.

item.title: Dental Sealants
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Dental sealants provide a powerful way for you to protect your teeth. They act as a preventative measure against cavities and gum disease, help further encourage dental hygiene, and help save time and money in your dental care. At Artisan Dental, we focus on providing you with dental sealants that will protect your mouth from decay and give you a boost to your oral health. Both children and adults can get dental sealants.

How Do Dental Sealants Work?

Dental sealants are plastic coatings that are painted onto the chewing surfaces of your teeth. Normally performed on the back molars, these plastic coatings protect your teeth from plaque, tartar, and food particles that easily get into the grooves and depressions of your teeth. Sealants work to protect against bacteria that can grow and develop into cavities, pulpitis, and long-term tooth decay. Dental sealants, depending on the type used, also can contain fluoride, which helps strengthen the enamel by bonding with the grooves and fissures within the tooth.

Most often, dental sealants are provided for children prone to cavities along the back molars. For children, these sealants are an excellent way to protect children's baby teeth from harming their adjacent and adult teeth later on in life. However, they aren't just for children either. Adults can also get dental sealants for their back molars. These sealants have been shown to reduce the risk of teeth problems over time, making sealants excellent options for individuals and families.

At Artisan Dental, we provide dental sealants because we understand the many benefits to people in our communities. These benefits include:

  • Preventing Tooth Decay: For teeth with deep grooves can prevent the possibility of cavities forming.
  • Cost-Effective Care: Because of its effectiveness at preventing decay, they're cost-effective for families and individuals needing dental care.
  • Long-Lasting Solution: Dental sealants can last as long as 15 years with proper dental hygiene and regular dental visits.
  • No Side Effects: There are no reported side effects from using dental sealants and are highly practical.

Our Dental Sealant Procedure at Artisan Dental

Getting sealants from our team at Artisan Dental is a two-step process. It begins with the application of gel that will pit the surfaces of the treated tooth. This gel allows us to roughen the surface of the inner tooth and allow the sealant material to attach to the tooth's enamel. After the gel, the dental sealant is applied, and the sealant will adhere to the tooth's surface. In some cases, our dentists may use curing lights to harden the material to the grooves and fissures for a tighter seal. Once completed, regular cleaning will be performed, and your treatment is complete.

Visiting our practice will give you all the tools you need to have good oral care for yourself and your family. Visit us today in Madison, Wisconsin, for more information about receiving dental care from our team.

item.title: Bite Guard
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
When it comes to treating your teeth, our dentists at Artisan Dental have multiple treatment options available to help you have a healthy smile. Among those options are bite guards. These devices have multiple uses for people of all ages and can protect your teeth while you sleep and protect your mouth during high-impact sports.

Why Choose Custom-Fit Bite Guards?

Bite guards or brux guards work to provide protection for the teeth and gums through the use of a protective plastic material that is custom fit to your mouth and custom fit to the way your teeth bite together. 

Teeth grinding and Clenching

Teeth grinding and clenching while you sleep can lead to many dental issues when left untreated. Headaches, sore jaw muscles, tooth pain, and broken teeth can occur because of either voluntary or involuntary grinding while sleeping. Also known as bruxism, this condition can affect your bite pattern, increase stress levels, lead to chipping or cracks in teeth and create poor dental alignment as a result.

Our dentists at Artisan Dental can provide multiple treatment options for bruxism, with one of them being mouth guards. Our mouth guards can help protect the enamel from breaking, protect the jaw muscles, and keep your mouth healthy. Our team will work with you to provide fitted bite guards that can help reduce the amount of bruxism-related pain so you can have a better sleep.

High Impact Sports Injuries

Another reason mouth guards are recommended is due to their ability to reduce the number of traumatic injuries experienced during sports. Studies have been able to reduce the number of injuries sustained during sports due to its ability to block direct blows to the temporomandibular joint and jawline during impact. With customized bite guards, the thickness and feel of the mouthguard can be adjusted to help prevent future injuries and protect people’s teeth during sports. This material is soft enough to provide comfort for the mouth but strong enough to handle pressure and potential impact. Mouthguards are a highly personalized treatment, using the impressions of the patient's teeth to create a guard that’s custom-fitted to the mouth.

 

While some mouth guards can be purchased over the counter, having a personalized mouthguard can provide you with substantial benefits, including:

  • Optimal Safety: Because of the layers of superheated plastic and resin materials used to make custom-fitted mouthguards, these guards can provide you with protection.
  • Reduced Concussion Risk: During sports, wearing a custom-fitted mouthguard can help prevent the onset of serious concussion injuries that occur near and around the jawbone.
  • Prevents Jaw Fractures: The material used to create custom-fitted bite guards acts as a cushion for the upper and lower jaw, preventing jaw fractures.
  • Enhanced Comfort: Because of the softer materials, those with bruxism can have a more reliable time sleeping without the worry of discomfort and potential tooth grinding.

 

Choose Artisan Dental For Bite Guards

When you visit Artisan Dental in Madison, Wisconsin, you’ll receive custom-fitted night guards and mouth guards that are designed to last. For more information about our services, contact us today to arrange an appointment and get started towards better oral care.

item.title: New Smile Design
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Look your very best!

Have You Considered A New Smile Design?

People choose new smile design services to assist with a variety of challenges including those outlined below.  If you have any of these common issues and would like to explore enhancing your smile, it would be Dr. Andersen’s pleasure to help you!

Schedule Your Consultation Learn More
We Can Fix These

Common Issues

Tooth Discoloration

Crooked Teeth

Gaps in Teeth

Crowded Teeth

Missing Teeth

Misshapen Teeth

Length/Proportions

Chipped Teeth

Cracked Teeth

Worn Teeth

Gummy Smile

Stained Teeth

Meet Dr. Andersen

Warm, friendly, compassionate

Experienced Dentist for Beautiful, Confident Smiles

Dr. Nicole Andersen’s passion for changing someone’s life by making them comfortable and confident with one of their most important assets—a beautiful smile—shows in the extensive cosmetic dentistry she has performed over the last 15 years. Patients have come from all over the area to take advantage of Dr. Anderson’s skill and expertise in Cosmetic Dentistry.

Dr. Andersen is committed to exceptional, quality care and aesthetically-beautiful outcomes, which results from her hundreds of hours of specialized, hands-on training in cosmetic dental care with some of the world's most qualified professors and instructors. You can learn more about Dr. Andersen’s training as an expert cosmetic dentist by visiting her biography.

Dr. Andersen understands that aesthetics are an important part of dental work and she loves helping patients look their best. She will take great care to ensure that you have a beautiful smile that is natural-looking and long-lasting.

View Doctor Bio
Don't Wait For Any Longer

Feel Your Very Best!

Enhance your level of comfort and confidence with your smile at work, at home and with friends.

Enhance the Beauty of Your Smile

Upgrade and refine the shape, color, brightness and proportions of your teeth to an aesthetic you have always wished for.

Relieve Pain and Stabilize Your Bite

Teeth can become worn and weakened by misaligned teeth coming together during the chewing process. Cosmetic, partial or full mouth restoration can correct this, reducing or eliminating pain and pro-longing the life of your teeth.

Strengthen Your Teeth

A new smile design can entail restoring and supporting your natural teeth with the most contemporary techniques and materials including porcelain crowns and porcelain veneers.

Speak More Clearly

When teeth are missing, broken, chipped or dentures are improperly fitted, speaking can be a challenge. With a new smile design, the natural shape of your mouth can be restored, enabling you to more easily communicate with those around you.

Chew Better

It's often difficult to chew when your teeth are misaligned or you are missing teeth. By restoring and aligning your teeth, you will be able to eat without pain or discomfort and enjoy your favorite foods again.

Stop Bone Loss and Decay

Damaged or missing teeth can affect your overall oral health.  When teeth are missing or decaying, there is a risk of bone loss. By replacing teeth with a dental implant and crown, you are stabilizing your oral health and jaw bone, enabling you to maintain your facial structure around the mouth and setting the stage for oral health in the future. 

A New Smile Design

In Just 4 Simple Steps:

Your smile is unique, which means we will create a customized treatment plan designed around your goals and visions for your new smile. The process entails four easy steps.

Complimentary Cosmetic Consultation

Take advantage of our Complimentary Cosmetic Consultation to meet Dr. Andersen and begin your smile design process. 

Step #1

Understanding You and Your Goals

Time is created for Dr. Andersen to perform a comprehensive exam of your overall oral health.  Dr. Andersen will review your historical treatment records and X-rays.  She will also take photographs that will assist in the creation of dental models of your teeth.  Dr. Andersen will then listen to your needs, wishes and goals regarding what you hope to see and experience when your smile is complete.

Step #2

Review Your Individualized Treatment Plan

Dr. Andersen will combine your overall oral health and aesthetic preferences to formulate an individualized treatment plan.  The plan brings together suggestions to foster your overall oral health and aesthetic preferences, leading to increased levels of confidence in your new smile.

Step #3

Smile Design Preparation

After you approve the final design for your smile,  Dr. Andersen will complete the tooth preparation work.

Step #4

Smile Design Completion

Your final visits will include Dr. Andersen fitting and bonding your veneers or crowns to your teeth, along with any final gum sculpting.  Steps 3 and 4 are comfortable with a range of spa-like amenities for your enjoyment and ease. The final outcome is a beautiful, healthy smile for years to come.

https://youtu.be/QqREmap3nOQhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fh6IQb8i6Sc
We have felixble payment options.

COMPLIMENTARY COSMETIC CONSULTATION

We provide complimentary consultations, where you have the opportunity to meet Dr. Andersen. During the complimentary consultation, she will recommend cosmetic dental approaches designed to help you achieve your vision and goals. Dr. Andersen will then provide an outline of the next steps in the process.

Once your treatment plan is completed, our patient care coordinators will work with you to identify any dental insurance coverage you may have for the procedures. We will also review discounts available through the Artisan Dental Health Plan or payment the day of services. Lastly, we work closely with affiliated third-party financial partner, CareCredit to create affordable payment options.

View Payment Options

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in realizing your smile restoration goals.

Call or email to schedule your appointment with Dr. Andersen and discuss your smile design goals.

Schedule Your Consultation Call 608-467-8022

Procedures We Use to Create Your New Smile

Dr. Andersen will create a custom treatment plan to enhance your smile and give it the appearance you’ve always wanted. The procedures she uses to create your new smile might include:

Porcelain Veneers

Porcelain veneers are thin porcelain coverings that are bonded to the front of your teeth to change their shape, size and/or color. Porcelain veneers can usually be completed in two visits and can make a dramatic change to your smile.

Dental Crowns

A dental crown is used when the tooth needs cosmetic changes and structural repair. A crown can also be used on top of an implant post to replace a missing tooth.

Teeth Whitening

Teeth whitening can be a quick way to markedly enhance your smile. It is an easy solution for people who want to improve the color of their teeth with minimal procedures. Remove stains from coffee, smoking or other common causes with a painless teeth whitening treatment at Artisan Dental.

Dental Bonding

Dental bonding is a tooth-colored dental resin that can be used to correct flaws such as chips and minor cracks in a tooth. It can also be used to change the size, shape or color of your teeth, but is not as durable and long-lasting as veneers.

Laser Gum Sculpting for a Gummy Smile or Uneven Gum Line

Uneven gum lines and gums that are too large around your teeth can cause your smile to look unattractive, and in some cases can affect your overall oral health. For most gum reshaping procedures the doctor uses a dental laser as a minimally-invasive way to sculpt the gum tissue.

Invisalign® & SureSmile® Teeth Straightening

Effective clear aligner treatment designed to fit your lifestyle. Clear aligners are designed to orchestrate each step of your smile transformation with precision.

Dental Implants

Dental implants are considered the modern solution for replacing missing teeth. A titanium post is inserted into your jaw and topped by a crown, which looks, acts and feels just like a natural tooth. We are usually able to provide all stages of your implant treatment in-house.

Dental Bridges

A dental bridge is a series of connected crowns that is used to replace one or more missing teeth. Although they have certain disadvantages compared to implants, bridges are a suitable option for replacing missing teeth in certain circumstances.

Full Mouth Restoration

A full-mouth restoration can handle decayed, cracked or damaged teeth to full health and function and allow you to smile again with confidence. Dr. Andersen provides comprehensive dental services and has the skills necessary to make your full-mouth restoration successful. She is experienced in handling extensive cases, and is partner to one of the country’s best aesthetic dental labs to make sure the work you have done is not only strong and durable, but also looks aesthetic and natural.

Look your very best!

Have You Considered A New Smile Design?

We Can Fix These

Meet Dr. Andersen

Warm, friendly, compassionate

Experienced Dentist for Beautiful, Confident Smiles

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]
View Doctor Bio
Don't Wait For Any Longer

Feel Your Very Best!

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]

Enhance the Beauty of Your Smile

Upgrade and refine the shape, color, brightness and proportions of your teeth to an aesthetic you have always wished for.

Relieve Pain and Stabilize Your Bite

Teeth can become worn and weakened by misaligned teeth coming together during the chewing process. Cosmetic, partial or full mouth restoration can correct this, reducing or eliminating pain and pro-longing the life of your teeth.

Strengthen Your Teeth

A new smile design can entail restoring and supporting your natural teeth with the most contemporary techniques and materials including porcelain crowns and porcelain veneers.

Speak More Clearly

When teeth are missing, broken, chipped or dentures are improperly fitted, speaking can be a challenge. With a new smile design, the natural shape of your mouth can be restored, enabling you to more easily communicate with those around you.

Chew Better

It's often difficult to chew when your teeth are misaligned or you are missing teeth. By restoring and aligning your teeth, you will be able to eat without pain or discomfort and enjoy your favorite foods again.

Stop Bone Loss and Decay

Damaged or missing teeth can affect your overall oral health.  When teeth are missing or decaying, there is a risk of bone loss. By replacing teeth with a dental implant and crown, you are stabilizing your oral health and jaw bone, enabling you to maintain your facial structure around the mouth and setting the stage for oral health in the future. 

A New Smile Design

In Just 4 Simple Steps:

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]

Complimentary Cosmetic Consultation

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]

Understanding You and Your Goals

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]
Step #2

Review Your Individualized Treatment Plan

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]
Step #3

Smile Design Preparation

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]
Step #4

Smile Design Completion

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]
We have felixble payment options.

COMPLIMENTARY COSMETIC CONSULTATION

We provide complimentary consultations, where you have the opportunity to meet Dr. Andersen. During the complimentary consultation, she will recommend cosmetic dental approaches designed to help you achieve your vision and goals. Dr. Andersen will then provide an outline of the next steps in the process.

Once your treatment plan is completed, our patient care coordinators will work with you to identify any dental insurance coverage you may have for the procedures. We will also review discounts available through the Artisan Dental Health Plan or payment the day of services. Lastly, we work closely with affiliated third-party financial partner, CareCredit to create affordable payment options.

View Payment Options

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in realizing your smile restoration goals.

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]
Schedule Your Consultation
Call 608-467-8022

Procedures We Use to Create Your New Smile

[elementor-element k="345e499e572341a5445276ea223511f3" data=""]

Porcelain Veneers

Porcelain veneers are thin porcelain coverings that are bonded to the front of your teeth to change their shape, size and/or color. Porcelain veneers can usually be completed in two visits and can make a dramatic change to your smile.

Dental Crowns

A dental crown is used when the tooth needs cosmetic changes and structural repair. A crown can also be used on top of an implant post to replace a missing tooth.

Teeth Whitening

Teeth whitening can be a quick way to markedly enhance your smile. It is an easy solution for people who want to improve the color of their teeth with minimal procedures. Remove stains from coffee, smoking or other common causes with a painless teeth whitening treatment at Artisan Dental.

Dental Bonding

Dental bonding is a tooth-colored dental resin that can be used to correct flaws such as chips and minor cracks in a tooth. It can also be used to change the size, shape or color of your teeth, but is not as durable and long-lasting as veneers.

Laser Gum Sculpting for a Gummy Smile or Uneven Gum Line

Uneven gum lines and gums that are too large around your teeth can cause your smile to look unattractive, and in some cases can affect your overall oral health. For most gum reshaping procedures the doctor uses a dental laser as a minimally-invasive way to sculpt the gum tissue.

Invisalign® & SureSmile® Teeth Straightening

Effective clear aligner treatment designed to fit your lifestyle. Clear aligners are designed to orchestrate each step of your smile transformation with precision.

Dental Implants

Dental implants are considered the modern solution for replacing missing teeth. A titanium post is inserted into your jaw and topped by a crown, which looks, acts and feels just like a natural tooth. We are usually able to provide all stages of your implant treatment in-house.

Dental Bridges

A dental bridge is a series of connected crowns that is used to replace one or more missing teeth. Although they have certain disadvantages compared to implants, bridges are a suitable option for replacing missing teeth in certain circumstances.

Full Mouth Restoration

A full-mouth restoration can handle decayed, cracked or damaged teeth to full health and function and allow you to smile again with confidence. Dr. Andersen provides comprehensive dental services and has the skills necessary to make your full-mouth restoration successful. She is experienced in handling extensive cases, and is partner to one of the country’s best aesthetic dental labs to make sure the work you have done is not only strong and durable, but also looks aesthetic and natural.

item.title: Carbon Negative
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
We are so excited to be the first!

Artisan Dental is the first general dentistry practice in the United States whose operations have become carbon negative.

This means all of the carbon or greenhouse gas emissions associated with all aspects of patient care are at least 120% offset through the purchase of verified and validated carbon credits. All carbon associated with the operation of our office space, the production and shipping of oral care products and services to us, as well as transportation of team members to and from their homes and continuing education has been included in our offset program. Artisan collaborated with Carbon Credit Capital to assess our Scope 1, 2, & 3 greenhouse gas emissions. For more than a decade, Carbon Credit Capital has helped companies calculate and offset their carbon emissions using rigorous global standards.

At Artisan Dental we see carbon offsetting as an important element of a comprehensive plan to reduce our negative impacts and enhance our positive impacts. In addition to offsetting the carbon associated with your oral health care, Artisan Dental also purchases 100% of the electricity used during your oral care services from MG&E’s Green Power program. Using renewable energy sources from MG&E helps to prevent the emission of greenhouse gases. In addition, Artisan Dental offers its team members an incentive to use a wide range of carbon sensitive alternative modes of transportation. We also work cooperatively with our suppliers to consolidate products into fewer shipments and emphasize purchasing from suppliers such as Raw Office who also offsets the carbon associated with the production and delivery of its office products.

Importantly, Artisan Dental does not pass this cost of carbon offsetting onto our patients. We believe this is part of fulfilling our mission of serving one of our most important stakeholders, a healthy thriving environment.

Artisan Dental’s collaboration with GreenTree’s and Carbon Credit Capital has contributed to a range of United Nations Sustainable Development Goals including

The carbon credits Artisan Dental purchased are derived from GreenTrees (ACRE) reforestation program in the Mississippi Valley. The ACRE project (Advanced Carbon Restored Eco-system) plants and grows new forests to sequester carbon, restore biodiversity, and clean and restore watersheds through new eco-system creation on degraded lands. Over regular intervals, independent verifiers measure how much carbon GreenTrees’ new forests have sequestered, and for each metric tonne reduced, one carbon credit is created.

item.title: Covid-19 Updates
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Dear Patients,

Infection control has always been a top priority for our practice and you may have seen this during your visits to our office. Our infection control processes are made so that when you receive care, it’s both safe and comfortable. We want to tell you about the infection control procedures we follow and the new practices we have introduced since COVID-19 to keep patients and our team safe. Our office follows infection control recommendations made by the American Dental Association (ADA), the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA). We follow the activities of these agencies so that we are up-to-date on any new rulings or guidance that may be issued. We do this to make sure that our infection control procedures are current and adhere to each agencies’ recommendations. You may see some changes when it is time for your next appointment. We are using industry leading practices to help protect our patients and team. Disinfection and Air-Filtration:

  • We have purchased eleven IQ Air, Health Pro Plus, hospital grade air filters with multi-stage filtration of particles down to .003 microns, which is significantly smaller in size than Covid-19 at approximately .125 microns.  One air filter has been placed in each of our patient treatment rooms, one in the waiting room and one at our front desk area.  All eleven filters will be operating continuously throughout the day.  These air filters will clean all the air in each treatment room once every 6 minutes.  You can learn more about these filters at https://www.iqair.com/.
  • In addition, we have also upgraded our HVAC filters to MERV11 which traps up to 95% of airborne particles.
  • We will continue to use EPA approved surface disinfecting solutions and using disinfecting protocols recommended by the CDC and OSHA between each patient.

Enhanced Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):

  • Our clinical team is provided with the highest quality Personal Protective Equipment available.
  • Due to the additional PPE that our clinical team will be wearing, we will be keeping our office cooler than we have in the past. You may want to dress more warmly for your appointment. We also have blankets available, which are laundered after each patient use.

Reception:

  • We have rearranged our reception area to make social distancing easy.

Patient Information: 

  • We will provide masks for those who choose to wear one.
  • We will provide hand sanitizer in the office for you to use as needed.
  • We provide each patient with protective eye wear for their appointment. This eye wear is sterilized after each patient use, but if you feel more comfortable bringing your own, we encourage you to do so.
  • If you prefer, you may wait in your car and we can call you when we are ready to see you. If you choose to do this, please call us when you arrive to check in.

We will continue to closely monitor updates from the American Dental Association, Centers for Disease Control, Occupational Safety and Health Administration(OSHA) and will continue to seek guidance from these agencies and public health officials.  We will keep you informed of any changes. We look forward to seeing you again and are happy to answer any questions you may have about the steps we are taking to keep you, and every patient, safe in our practice. To make an appointment, please call our office at 608.467.8022 or visit our website at www.artisandentalmadison.com. Thank you for being our patient. We value your trust and loyalty and look forward to welcoming back our patients, neighbors and friends. Sincerely, Dr. Nicole Andersen and Team

  • We have purchased eleven IQ Air, Health Pro Plus, hospital grade air filters with multi-stage filtration of particles down to .003 microns, which is significantly smaller in size than Covid-19 at approximately .125 microns.\u00a0 One air filter has been placed in each of our patient treatment rooms, one in the waiting room and one at our front desk area.\u00a0 All eleven filters will be operating continuously throughout the day. \u00a0These air filters will clean\u00a0all<\/u><\/strong>\u00a0the air in each treatment room once every 6 minutes.\u00a0\u00a0You can learn more about these filters at\u00a0https:\/\/www.iqair.com\/<\/a>.<\/li><\/ul>
    • We have invested in a hospital grade UV-C disinfecting light that will be used after recommended surface cleaning and disinfection has occurred using EPA approved disinfecting\u00a0solutions.\u00a0 UV-C lights disinfect the air, hard and varied surfaces.\u00a0You can learn more about UV-C disinfecting at\u00a0https:\/\/www.steril-aire.com\/product\/remedial-in-room-decontamination-system-rids\/<\/a>.<\/li><\/ul>
      • To ensure air traveling into our facility from our heating and cooling system is disinfected, we have also invested in hospital grade UV-C disinfecting lights that will be positioned at each of our 6 air handling units.\u00a0 You can learn more about UV-C disinfection in HVAC systems at\u00a0https:\/\/www.steril-aire.com\/products\/hvac-surface-airstream-solutions\/<\/a><\/li><\/ul>
        • In addition, we have also upgraded our HVAC filters to MERV11 which traps up to 95% of airborne particles.<\/li><\/ul>
          • We will continue to use EPA approved surface\u00a0disinfecting solutions and using disinfecting protocols recommended by the CDC and OSHA between each patient. We will be increasing the frequency of\u00a0disinfection of all hard surfaces in the patient waiting room, front desk, patient consultation rooms, door handles and team member work spaces on an hourly basis in additional to UV-C light disinfection.<\/li><\/ul>
            • We have hired 2 additional team members to assist with patient care and disinfection.<\/li><\/ul>

              Enhanced Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):<\/strong><\/p>

              • Our team is provided with the highest quality Personal Protective Equipment available.<\/li><\/ul>
                • Due to the additional PPE that our team will be wearing, we will be keeping our office cooler than we have in the past. You may want to dress more warmly for your appointment. We also have blankets available, which are laundered after each patient use.<\/li><\/ul>

                  Reception:<\/strong><\/p>

                  • We have rearranged our reception area and placed social distancing indicators on the floor to make social distancing easy.<\/li><\/ul>
                    • Our waiting room will no longer offer books, iPads, water and so forth, since those items are difficult to clean and disinfect.<\/li><\/ul>

                      Patient Information:\u00a0<\/strong><\/p>

                      • Our office will communicate with you 2 days before your appointment to ask some screening questions. We will review these same questions to note any changes when you arrive for your appointment.
                        • One new requirement that we are asking of our patients is to complete a Medical History and COVID-19 screening 2 days prior to your appointment either online or by calling our office.<\/li><\/ul><\/li><\/ul>
                          • Patients are required to wear a mask while in our office. If you do not have one, we will provide you with one.<\/li><\/ul>
                            • We will also provide you with hand sanitizer that we will ask you to use when you enter the\u00a0office. You will also find some in the reception area and other places in the office for you to use\u00a0as needed.<\/li><\/ul>
                              • We provide each patient with protective eye wear for their appointment. This eye wear is\u00a0sterilized after each patient use, but if you feel more comfortable bringing your own, we\u00a0encourage you to do so.<\/li><\/ul>
                                • We ask that you come alone to your appointment in order to reduce the number of people in\u00a0the reception area. Only the patient will be allowed in the clinical operatory, with rare\u00a0exceptions.<\/li><\/ul>
                                  • Please arrive 5 or fewer minutes before your appointment.<\/li><\/ul>
                                    • We ask that you bring only essential items to your appointment (e.g. keys, phone, form of\u00a0payment, reading material).<\/li><\/ul>
                                      • If you prefer, you may wait in your car and we can call you when we are ready to see you. If you choose to do this, please call us when you arrive to check in.<\/li><\/ul>
                                        • We will be taking your temperature when you arrive for your appointment and our team\u00a0members\u2019 temperature each day to notice any signs of increased immune system activity that\u00a0may suggest an illness.<\/li><\/ul>

                                          We will continue to closely monitor updates from the\u00a0American Dental Association<\/a>,\u00a0Centers for Disease Control<\/a>,\u00a0Occupational Safety and Health Administration(OSHA)<\/a>\u00a0and will continue to seek guidance from these agencies and public health officials.\u00a0 We will keep you informed of any changes.<\/p>

                                          We look forward to seeing you again and are happy to answer any questions you may have about the steps we are taking to keep you, and every patient, safe in our practice. To make an appointment, please call our office at 608.467.8022 or visit our website at\u00a0www.artisandentalmadison.com<\/a>.<\/p>

                                          Thank you for being our patient. We value your trust and loyalty and look forward to welcoming back our patients, neighbors and friends.<\/p>

                                          Sincerely,<\/p>

                                          Dr Nicole Andersen and teama<\/p>"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Madelyn
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
I graduated from Milwaukee Area Technical College in 2016 and have spent most of my dental hygiene career in Madison where I take pride in providing quality care and information to patients while building a trusting relationship.

While I was born and raised in Madison, I spent six years living in Milwaukee while pursuing my education. I enjoyed my time there and still visit frequently! I love spending summers in the sun and patio hopping, while spending winters cozied up at home with a good book or Netflix series. In my spare time, I also work hard on my personal fitness and creating a healthy lifestyle.

I look forward to working with the community and continuing my career with Artisan Dental!

item.title: FAQ's
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Do I need root canal treatment?

You may need a root canal if tooth decay or a broken tooth has allowed the pulp to become infected and inflamed. Signs and symptoms to watch out for include temperature sensitivity, swelling, drainage, odor, pain, and discoloration of the tooth. It is important to treat infections quickly, as delaying treatment can result in severe tooth pain and abscess.

What should I expect to happen during my root canal?

Once the tooth is numb, an opening will be made in the top of your tooth to access the canals. Your dentist will use tiny instruments to remove pulp from your tooth and prepare it to be filled. You will return at a later date to have a crown fabricated that will give it the appearance and function of a natural tooth.

Will I need to follow any post-operative instructions following my root canal treatment?

You will be allowed to drive yourself home from your root canal visit and may even wish to return to work the same day. However, it is normal for your tooth to be sensitive in the days following your procedure. You’ll need to avoid biting anything with your filled tooth, as this can cause it to break or fracture. So long as the tooth heals normally and you experience no complications, you can return to your dentist within a month to have a crown or other restoration placed on the tooth.

Office Hours

SunClosed  
Mon7:00 AM -5:00 PM
Tue7:00 AM -5:00 PM
Wed7:00 AM -5:00 PM
Thur7:00 AM -5:00 PM
Fri7:00 AM -5:00 PM
SatClosed 

Additional Information

Bike Storage: The 2nd floor of the parking garage under Artisan has a dedicated bike rack for your use.

The bike rack is located on the NE corner of the building.

B Cycle Stations: There is a B Cycle station just one block away in front of Breese Stevens Field. (Paterson and E Washington)

Also, S Livingston and E Main near the Sylvie.

Bus Routes: Accessible on Madison Metro Routes (2,3,4,5,6,27,29,37,56,57)

Free Parking:  in the Constellation Building

Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy: Please contact us at least 48 hours prior to your scheduled visit to enable other patients to be cared for during your appointment time.

To make an appointment with our Madison dentist, please complete the form available here. Otherwise, we welcome you to contact our patient care coordinator directly during our normal office hours

item.title: Wellness Series

item.content:encoded:
Upcoming Events

Coming Soon

The Artisan Dental Wellness Series is a quarterly wellness and community building series, designed to foster whole person wellness, enjoyment and a sense of connection among Artisan Dental stakeholders (patients, staff, suppliers, community and planet).

Every quarter, Artisan Dental sponsors a Wellness Series event, featuring an expert or experience designed to support greater levels of health and happiness.  All Artisan Dental patients, together with a friend are welcome to participate, free of charge, on first come, first reserved basis for each event.

You can learn about upcoming events by visiting this page of our website. Notices will be placed on our Facebook & Twitter pages. Artisan Dental patients will also receive an announcement in our monthly e-newsletter.

To reserve a place at an upcoming event simply email or call our office at:

info@artisandentalmadison.com or Ph. 608-467-8022

item.title: Artisan Dental Botox Plan
item.dc:creator: lindsayh
item.content:encoded:
Artisan Dental has been providing exceptional quality care for generations, and through the cosmetic expertise of Dr. Andersen, our dentists are able to administer Botulinum Toxin, or Botox, for dental therapy and esthetic purposes. Our practice provides cosmetic Botox treatments for our patients to help create better facial esthetics, meet your cosmetic dental needs, and give you comprehensive treatment plans that improve your oral health.

Why Use Botox in Cosmetic Dentistry?

Botox in dentistry has been expanding over the last few years. While primarily used to treat wrinkles and fine lines, Botox in a medical context has been used to help treat various conditions, including TMJ disorder, bruxism, and even facial muscle training for fitting dentures. Botox can provide patients with not only relief to their medical issues but also provide better facial symmetry and complexion through its use.

For dental treatment, patients with a number of cosmetic problems can find a long-term solution with Botox. Studies have shown that Botox can be applied to both medical and cosmetic reasons due to how it essentially slows down muscle contractions and glandular secretions by inhibiting the acetylcholine neurotransmitter. When injected into the muscle, it reduces the contractions and tone of the muscle and shows promise for treating dental conditions affected by muscle and skin formations, including:

  • Gummy Smile

Often, the appearance of a gummy smile can be visually displeasing to some patients. Patients who wish to correct this issue can receive Botox as a potential option. Through this treatment, a small amount of Botox is injected into the muscle responsible for lifting the upper lip while smiling to reduce the visibility of the gums.

  • Wide Jaw Line

For those who wish to slim down the appearance of their jawline, Botox can also be used to reduce the muscle mass of the masseter's muscle and create a slimmer facial jaw. The injection will be used primarily as an esthetic or cosmetic treatment but can also be used as a form of therapy.

  • Wrinkles, Lines, and Creases

With the appearance of fine lines, dimples, creases, and wrinkles, Botox therapy can provide a sense of relaxation and help remove these lines as a form of facial rejuvenation. All areas of interest should be discussed with your facial esthetician or dentist for more information.

  • Denture and Restoration Transition

Patients receiving dentures, implants, or other orthodontic devices may need to have adjustments to their facial features, especially if the shape or placement of their teeth causes discomfort throughout the mouth and jaw. Botox injections can help relieve any pain or discomfort felt from post-restorative treatment.

Through our training in facial esthetics and dental care, you will receive exceptional quality, esthetically beautiful dental care that has proven results. Contact Artisan Dental today to learn more about our Botox treatments.

Contact Us

Studies have shown that Botox can be applied to both medical and cosmetic reasons due to how it essentially slows down muscle contractions and glandular secretions by\u00a0<\/span>inhibiting the acetylcholine neurotransmitter<\/span><\/a>. When injected into the muscle, it reduces the contractions and tone of the muscle and shows promise for treating dental conditions affected by muscle and skin formations, including:<\/span><\/p>

  • Gummy Smile<\/b><\/h4><\/li><\/ul>

    Often, the appearance of a gummy smile can be visually displeasing to some patients. Patients who wish to correct this issue can receive Botox as a potential option. Through this treatment, a small amount of Botox is injected into the muscle responsible for lifting the upper lip while smiling to reduce the visibility of the gums.<\/span><\/p>

    • Wide Jaw Line<\/b><\/h4><\/li><\/ul>

      For those who wish to slim down the appearance of their jawline, Botox can also be used to reduce the muscle mass of the masseter's muscle and create a slimmer facial jaw. The injection will be used primarily as an esthetic or cosmetic treatment but can also be used as a form of therapy.<\/span><\/p>

      • Wrinkles, Lines, and Creases<\/b><\/h4><\/li><\/ul>

        With the appearance of fine lines, dimples, creases, and wrinkles, Botox therapy can provide a sense of relaxation and help remove these lines as a form of facial rejuvenation. All areas of interest should be discussed with your facial esthetician or dentist for more information.<\/span><\/p>

        • Denture and Restoration Transition<\/b><\/h4><\/li><\/ul>

          Patients receiving dentures, implants, or other orthodontic devices may need to have adjustments to their facial features, especially if the shape or placement of their teeth causes discomfort throughout the mouth and jaw. Botox injections can help <\/span>relieve any pain or discomfort<\/span><\/a> felt from post-restorative treatment.<\/span><\/p>

          Through our training in facial esthetics and dental care, you will receive exceptional quality, esthetically beautiful dental care that has proven results. Contact Artisan Dental today to learn more about our Botox treatments.<\/span><\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"12","right":"12","bottom":"12","left":"12","isLinked":"1"},"_ha_condition_list":[{"_id":"79369b5"}],"ha_advanced_tooltip_content":"I am a tooltip"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"7c305d2","elType":"widget","settings":{"text":"Contact Us","link":{"url":"https:\/\/artisandentalmadison.com\/contact-us\/","is_external":"","nofollow":"","custom_attributes":""},"align":"center","size":"lg","button_text_color":"#FFFFFF","background_color":"#321C0E","_ha_condition_list":[{"_id":"ec8434b"}],"ha_advanced_tooltip_content":"I am a tooltip"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"button"}],"isInner":""}],"isInner":""}]

item.content:encoded:
Botox for Therapeutics & Esthetics

The Benefits of Botox® Therapy in Esthetic Dentistry

At Artisan Dental, we appreciate the opportunity to fulfill our mission of providing exceptional quality care that is empathetic and compassionate. Building on Dr. Andersen’s extensive experience in cosmetic dentistry, Dr. Rehermann has received specialized training regarding the administration of Botulinum Toxin - Botox® for dental therapeutic and esthetic purposes from the American Academy of Facial Esthetics.

We understand that looking and feeling your best can contribute to your overall sense of happiness and well being and look forward to partnering with you to create individualized treatment plans for all of your oral health, cosmetic dental and facial esthetic needs and wishes.

Alexandra's Photos Courtesy of Allergan

Ava's Photos Courtesy of Allergan

David's Photos Courtesy of Allergan

Catherine's Photos Courtesy of Allergan

Levon's Photos Courtesy of Allergan

Leann's Photos Courtesy of Allergan

Reasons patients may consider Botulinum toxin or Botox® therapy for dental conditions and esthetic goals include:

Gummy Smile

A common goal with Botox® therapy is to help reduce the appearance of a gummy smile. The treatment works by injecting a small amount of Botox into the muscle responsible for lifting the upper lip when smiling, helping to reduce the visibility of the gums without gingival surgery or crown lengthening.

Transition to Dentures, Dental Implants or Orthodontics

If the shape or placement of teeth have been or are being altered by dentures, dental implants or orthodontics, causing discomfort, Botox® treatments injected around the mouth can help relax the area and relieve pain and discomfort.

Jaw Line Slimming

Botox® can also be used to reduce the muscle mass in the masseters (jaw line) for a slimming facial esthetic result.

In addition to Botox® dental therapeutic applications, Botox® can also be used for esthetic purposes. We are happy to discuss this esthetic applications with you as well.

Facial Rejuvenation

The goal of Botox® therapy is to provide a sense of rejuvenation, smoothing out unwanted lines, creasing and wrinkles.

Areas of interest may include:

  • Glabellar area (The 11's/frown lines between the eyes)
  • Frontalis muscles (Forehead lines-Crow’s feet)
  • Chin dimples
  • Radial lip lines (smoker’s lines)
  • Nose lines “bunny lines”

Refresh and Rejuvenate with
Esthetic Botox

In Just 4 Simple Steps

With your goals and vision in mind, we will create a customized
treatment plan. The process entails four easy steps.

Step #1

Understand You and Your Goals

During a complimentary consultation, Dr. Rehermann will listen to your goals and what you hope to see and experience when your treatment is complete.  Through this discussion, an individualized treatment plan will be created that incorporates facial and dental proportions, together with proper lip and smile lines for ideal results.

Step #2

Before Treatment

Please schedule Botox® appointments at least two weeks in advance of any special events. You’ll be asked to avoid alcohol a day before treatment and avoid anti-inflammatories, vitamin E, St. John’s Wort, gingko one week before treatments.

Step #3

During Treatment

Treatments usually last around 15-30 minutes. 
Expect a mild pinch as the treatment gets underway.
Depending on the number of treatments, you can expect three to ten injections per treatment area.

Step #4

After Treatment

Treatment effects can be noticed after 2 hours with full effects
taking approximately 7-10 days.
Please plan any other cosmetic procedures 2 weeks after your
Botox® treatment.
Please avoid vigorous exercise and heat for one day after treatment.

After Treatment

Why Artisan Dental for Botox

  • Our dentists have advanced training in facial and esthetic treatments.
  • Integration of facial and dental proportions, together with proper lip and smile lines for ideal results
  • Trained by world renowned mentors in facial esthetics.
  • Convenience of combining esthetic treatments and dental care.

Experience Year Long Savings, With The Artisan Dental Botox Plan

Get Started

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Botox®?

Botox® is the trade name for Botulinum Toxin, a neurotoxin in the form of a purified protein. The mechanism of action for Botulinum Toxin (Botox®) is really quite simple; it is injected into facial muscles but really doesn’t affect the muscle at all. Botulinum Toxin (Botox®) works by blocking the transmitters between the motor nerves that innervate the muscle.

The areas typically treated with Botulinum Toxin  (Botox®) for wrinkles are the forehead, between the eyes (glabellar region), around the corners of the eyes (crow’s feet) and  around the lips (smokers lines or gummy smile). There is no loss of sensory feeling in the muscles. Once the motor nerve endings are interrupted, the muscle cannot contract, causing wrinkles in the skin to smooth. The effects of Botulinum Toxin (Botox®) last approximately three to four months, at which time the patient will require re-treatment.

Botulinum Toxin (Botox®) has important clinical uses as an adjunct in facial pain and bruxism cases for patients with bruxism, chronic TMJ and orofacial pain. Botulinum Toxin (Botox®) is also used to complement esthetic dentistry as a minimally invasive alternative to surgery.

Botox® is one of the most widely known and popular wrinkle reduction treatments available today. Botox® is a non-surgical prescription medication that temporarily reduces frown lines, forehead lines, and crow’s feet.

How long does Botox® take?

Receiving Botox® takes only a few minutes and there’s no need for anesthesia or down time. The injections are made using a very fine needle and are minimally invasive.

Generally, results are visible within two to ten days. To reduce the possibility of bruising/swelling, it is recommended to avoid alcohol for at least 24 hours and aspirin/anti inflammatory medications for a period of two weeks prior to the procedure. As always, consult your physician before stopping any medications.

How long does Botox® last?

The esthetic effects of Botox® typically last three to four months, dependent upon each patient’s physical activity level. As the treated muscles regain movement, lines and wrinkles will begin to reappear and require re-treatment. With repeated treatment over time, these lines and wrinkles should appear less noticeable due to training the treated muscles to relax.

What are the side effects of Botox®?

The most common side effects of Botox® injections are bruising, redness, and swelling. Other, rare side effects are possible and will be reviewed by the treating dentist. To avoid adverse reactions/results, do not manipulate the treated area for 2 hours after injections and maintain an upright position.

How soon will I see results?

Botox® injections require no downtime and you will see the amazing results in a few days. A full effect may take up to two weeks but your new look will last for several months.

Is Botox® Painful?

Botox® consists of a series of mild injections which are extremely tolerable. On occasion minor bruising can occur but lasts only a few days.

Dr. Rehermann will work with you to design your treatment to minimize your discomfort. This is because some areas of the face require two to five almost painless injections with a thin needle. The Botox® injections take about 15 minutes and no anesthesia is required.

How does Botox® work?

Whenever you laugh, frown, concentrate or squint into the sun, your facial muscles contract and your skin creases. As you get older, your skin loses its elasticity and those creases deepen into lines that can become permanently etched on your face. Frown lines between your eyes can become particularly noticeable at a relatively young age, making you look angry or worried even when you’re not. By temporarily immobilizing the muscles you use to frown, Botox® can smooth out those lines, restoring a more youthful, less stressed expression to your face.

Injected into the skin, Botox® works by temporarily blocking nerve impulses to the injected muscles. By blocking nerve impulses Botox® is able reduce the muscle activity that causes unwanted fine lines and deep-set wrinkles. Many branches of medicine are using Botox® injections today to treat TMJ, Bruxism, migraines, and of course, for cosmetic purposes.

How do I know if Botox® is right for me?

Dr. Rehermann will evaluate your goals and the necessary steps to achieve them in a one-on-one complimentary consultation with you.

How much does Botox® cost?

Botox® is priced by the “unit” and one vial of Botox® contains 100 units. Your treatment plan will determine the number of units you will need to have an effective outcome and the number of units will determine the cost. Unlike surgical or dermatological treatments such as dermabrasion, costs can vary depending on the severity of wrinkling in the skin in the treatment area and how many units are used during each treatment. We are happy to provide you with an estimate of the cost during your complimentary consultation.

Who can administer Botox®?

Botox® is a prescription drug. In Wisconsin, Botox® can be administered by doctors, dentists and other allied health professionals. While it does not necessarily have to be administered in a doctor’s office, it can be beneficial to confirm the person who administers Botox® has been appropriately trained and credentialed.

Why choose a dentist for cosmetic Botox®?

Cosmetic Botox® injections have become a well-known procedure that can help reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles in the skin. Dr. Rehermann has received extensive training regarding the anatomy of the face and facial expression dynamics during dental school and during his training at the American Academy of Facial Esthetics. In addition, dentists are highly skilled at administering oral and facial injections due the daily injections they administer for anesthesia to numb dental patients prior to a procedure.

Dr. Rehermann is also able to collaborate with Dr. Andersen, leveraging her extensive training and experience in cosmetic dentistry to offer comprehensive facial and dental esthetic treatments that consider facial and dental proportions for optimal results.

Our patients also appreciate the convenience of being able to visit us for general and cosmetic dentistry services at the same time as they’re receiving their Botox® treatment.

Get Started
